Pirates set up shop south of McCathlyre!
LAND GRAB
Captain Jamal, a widely known figure in the pirating world has laid claim to the sparsely inhabited island chain south of McCathlyre. They have been dubbed “The Free Islands” by the captain, who has placed an open invitation for any and all pirates to come and take up arms to defend their rights to pillage in peace. The islands have been undeveloped territories for the kingdom for many years. According to royal economic advisor to the king the islands are Currently only inhabited by a few native tribes whom the kingdom was having difficulty taxing anyway. Will the kingdom respond with a military force? Or will they sit back and let the den of sin begin?
“Yarr I’m just happy to be a parrrt if somethin’ biggerr yah know?” Says career-deckhand Merl Sedgwick.
He plans on making his way to the islands just as soon as he can find his way off this barstool.
Ad: JOIN THE RANKS — THE FREE ISLES
FUCK EVERYTHING AND BECOME A PIRATE
Caption: Paid for by Captain Jamal of the free islands
GORTHAK UNITES ORC CLANS
Reports of abductions coming in!
Gorthak proclaimed leader of all orc clans!
ABDUCTIONS
Abductions reported in Thorhofn city.
“Every single day we get more reports coming in with abductions” “Not just women either, doesn’t seems to be a sex thing” Says Shamus Greerson, Captain of the watch.
Just last week, a witness proclaimed they saw a group of people wearing black cloth over their faces, taking people into the bushes behind the city gates. This is not the first time groups of people like this have been reported.
When the guards investigated the area the witness mentioned, there was nothing to be found.
When Rugby’s Gazette reached out to the witness, we were told she was missing now as well.
A CALL HOME
Former Nayeshe tribe leader Gorthak has been proclaimed ruler of the Orc clans Sunday morning. Tribal howling and celebrations could be heard from all who dared to venture near the newly proclaimed Orc Lands. Gorthak has issued a “call to return home” to all displaced members of any and all orcs. Blooding ceremonies and sacrifices have been taking place since his declaration. “For too long our brothers and sisters have lived as hated wretched creatures!”
The Squiylian cities of Morfi, Mever, and Holde have been captured and enslaved by Gorthak’s forces.
Caption: Gorthak, Ruler of the orc clans
Florenta man stops brawl by running everyone over with cart
STREET JUSTICE
It was just your typical 3 a.m. street fight outside of a bar in Florenta, Binneth until one Florenta Man went and ran everybody over.
Reports state that a group of guys were fighting around a few parked carriages outside of a bar that night.
According to locals, the driver of the cart was involved in the fight and trying to leave, but failed to complete the turn in the narrow street.
He smashed one fighter straight through the front windows of The Bad Monkey Bar.
After the incident, the driver of the cart fled the scene. The man who was driven into the bar suffered a minor leg and head injury, and the bar was stuck with 5,000 gold in damages.
If you have any information about the Florenta Man who performed the hit and run, please contact Florenta city guards at once.
Binneth lands see first signs of orcish invasion!
ORC IN CHAINS
After encountering an Orc scouting party, Binneth’s Royal-Elites managed to capture one of the Orcs, the larger of the lot which seemed to be their leader. The captive spoke of Gorthak, the powerful Orcish warlord that had united the clans into a mighty horde, which he was convinced would conquer the entire continent.
ORC SCOUT CAPTURED
The captive had in its possession a sending stone of sorts, a magical device with which it could communicate with its commanders. The royal-elites now make their way back to Beisfjord, to present their captive and their reconnaissance to Captain Vakrum. They are expected to arrive at midday today.
This is the first time the Orcish invasion of Squiyles has been seen on Binneth land. What does this mean for the impending war with the north? Rugby’s Gazette with be following closely folks!
Ad: BUSCY BARDS — AALIYAH, ELVEN BEAUTY
ELVES
Caption: Located in the Redlight District, Thorhofn City, Binneth
NEW PUBLICATIONS WHENEVER WE FEEL LIKE IT!
Canon facts

Captain Jamal, a pirate captain, has claimed the sparsely inhabited island chain south of McCathlyre, dubbing it “The Free Islands” / “The Free Isles,” and invites pirates to settle and defend it.
The Free Islands/Isles were previously undeveloped kingdom territory, difficult for the crown to tax, inhabited by a few native tribes.
Merl Sedgwick is a career-deckhand who intends to join Captain Jamal in the Free Islands.
Thorhofn city has experienced repeated abductions, reported daily; victims include women and others, taken by figures in black cloth near the city gates.
Shamus Greerson is Captain of the watch in Thorhofn (quoted on the abductions).
A witness to an abduction who spoke to a guard and then to Rugby’s Gazette later went missing herself (rumour-adjacent, but reported as fact by the paper).
Gorthak, former leader of the Nayeshe tribe, was proclaimed ruler/warlord of all the orc clans on a Sunday, uniting them into one horde.
Gorthak issued a “call to return home” to displaced orcs, accompanied by blooding ceremonies and sacrifices.
The Squiylian cities of Morfi, Mever, and Holde have been captured and enslaved by Gorthak’s forces.
A Florenta man (Binneth) caused a hit-and-run with a cart during a 3 a.m. street brawl outside The Bad Monkey Bar, injuring one fighter and causing 5,000 gold in damages; he fled and was being sought by Florenta city guards.
Binneth’s Royal-Elites captured an orc scout (the larger of a scouting party, believed to be its leader) in Binneth lands — the first sign of orcish invasion seen on Binneth soil.
The captured orc scout carried a magical “sending stone” used to communicate with orc commanders.
The Royal-Elites were en route to Beisfjord to present the captive and their reconnaissance to Captain Vakrum.
Aaliyah, an elf, is advertised as an entertainer (“Elven Beauty”) at Buscy Bards, located in the Redlight District of Thorhofn City, Binneth.
The Gazette is published out of Conopimalis, Erepec, Kingdom of Squiyles; this issue is dated (in-world) APRIL 15 4885.

gazette/2019-05-12.title: 2019-05-12 · Gazette, April 17 4900
gazette/2019-05-12.content:
In the news: factions/The Agency, npcs/Dr. E Brown, npcs/Ilestra’ Tarmuhn,
npcs/Hammond Hardle, places/Kingdom of Binneth, timeline
Paradox
“The Agency” gears up to solve space-time mystery
A group known only as “The Agency” is now investigating crimes against space-time.
Evidence is showing the possibility of a major space-time altering event having happened that has-and-is altering the course and shape of the multiverse in ways that are rippling through the very fibers of reality.
“We believe this is only the beginning, we are investigating any and all major events leading up to, and directly after what we are calling ‘Day Zero’ ”
“Even the simplest alteration to the space time continuum could have drastic results!” Say’s Agency founder Dr. E Brown. A space-time magic wizard and proponent of the abolishment of space-time magic altogether.
“Since discovering this magic, I’ve done everything possible to keep it under wraps!, The last thing the universe needs is people mucking about in the past creating paradoxes willy nilly along the way!”
Desperate times call for desperate measures, as various agents are being sent backward in time on one-way journeys to carefully course-correct history.
Caption: The book of Wisdom - Home of Prophet Ilestra’ Tarmuhn
Material Plane Vanishes
Fairy Upset
Fairy creatures react poorly to material plane refugees
Tricky and mischievous, the fairies have taken a distinct liking to toying and playing with the new refugees entering the Feywild.
Those entering the magical forests, laden with curious creatures and dangerous alike, have been in for many surprises.
“They turned all my wares into butterflies!” Says refugee and soon-to-be merchant Marcus Tervath.
“Everytime we try to set up camp the fairy’s come and muck about with all our stuff!”
The cultural differences between the refugees and the fey are palpable. It’s unclear whether a suitable long term relationship can be met that will allow for new arrivals from the material plane to ever exist “normally” here.
“They showed us to some berries to forage but the berries turned grandma into an oak tree!” Says new-local refugee child.
“I kinda like her better this way”.
A New Home
Those capable, evacuate Prime material plane!
Everyone! And I mean everyone folks! Has either evacuated or is simply gone due to the recent events that caused the material plane to cease to exist.
However! Rugby’s Gazette will not fail to keep on reporting! Our offices are currently being relocated but the journalism will continue during the move! Fear not faithful readers!
Reports are coming in stating the most common evacuation planes have been The Feywild, Shadowfell, and the Ethereal plane. What will happen next folks? Rugbys Gazette has its ear on the pulse!
Caption: Diagram of the planes
Beasts Unleashed
Rip in prison plane of Carceri dumps horrors back into multiverse
Nightmarish Horrors once thought to be fables and creatures of lore, dump back into the corners of reality.
Ilestra’ Tarmuhn Fey High-Oracle who lives in the book of wisdom has received a prophecy that vibrated though the very fibers of magic, and was felt and understood by every magic user in the Feywilds.
“Gone are the days of letting the nightmares fade with the morning light.
Gone are the moments of terror just being in your head.
Gone is the feeling of safety
Gone is the future for our children
Gone are the moments of subtle luxury
Gone are the winds of relaxation
Gone are the meek
Gone are the strong
Gone”
Dying of the Light
Last star went dark moments before vanishing of material plane
A Dark End
What had been puzzling astronomists for years will forever remain a mystery. Moments before evacuating the royal observatory in Binneth, Hammond Hardle, made one last observation.
“It went out”
“The last of the nights sky… … Extinguished”
As heartbreaking as this was Hammond needed to move fast. He gathered up what equipment he had in reach and made his way to the Feywild planar gate setup by the royal wizards.
One by one they left to seek refuge in the new world.
“I hope to shed light on this mystery, as well as explore the uncharted reaches of the Feywild cosmos.”
Things are still unclear what will happen to the royal leading figures of the displaced kingdom.
Canon facts

“The Agency” is a group investigating crimes against space-time; its founder is Dr. E Brown, a space-time magic wizard who wants space-time magic abolished.
The Agency’s investigation centers on an event it calls “Day Zero,” a major space-time-altering event rippling through the multiverse.
The Agency is sending agents backward in time on one-way journeys to “course-correct” history.
Rumour/claim: the material (Prime) plane has ceased to exist; survivors have evacuated or vanished.
The most common evacuation destinations reported are the Feywild, the Shadowfell, and the Ethereal plane.
Rugby’s Gazette is based in “Roaming Gazette-works, Plane of the Feywild” and was founded (EST) 3865; this issue is dated APRIL 17 4900 in-world.
Refugee Marcus Tervath, a soon-to-be merchant, had his wares turned into butterflies by fey pranksters.
An unnamed new-local refugee child reports fey turned their grandmother into an oak tree.
Ilestra’ Tarmuhn is the Fey High-Oracle who lives in “the book of wisdom” and received a prophecy felt by every magic user in the Feywild.
Rumour: a rip in the prison plane of Carceri has dumped “Nightmarish Horrors” back into the multiverse.
Hammond Hardle is associated with the royal observatory in Binneth; he made the last recorded astronomical observation (“the last of the nights sky… extinguished”) before evacuating via a Feywild planar gate set up by royal wizards.
The fate of “the royal leading figures of the displaced kingdom” (unnamed) is reported as unclear.

gazette/2019-06-10.title: 2019-06-10 · Gazette, April 24 4885
gazette/2019-06-10.content:
In the news: Holsoy, npcs/Corbin Strange, Acatlalco,
places/Howling Gulf, npcs/Rex Sauvage, npcs/Worick Dragon-bane, places/Isle of Torta,
Gorthak, Zakmed
Church of St. Cuthbert burns!
DRAGONS
The church of St. Cuthbert burns down to the ground in Holsoy this week.
This is yet another church subjected to what now seems like targeted attacks by the dragons.
We reached out to Corbin Strange, an exotic monsters and animals expert who works with the gazette.
“Dragons live a long time and think long term, they hold grudges that far outlive those that caused them.”
“I have a feeling these churches are paying for crimes they don’t even remember they commited”
“It’s also very strange for dragons to work together, they are normally very solitary creatures.”
Crazy as it is folks, be careful going to church these days! As you could end up meeting your maker a little quicker than anticipated!
NAVAL STANDOFF IN GULF
Reports of trolls leaving mountainous areas
Tensions are high in the high seas!
TROLLS SIGHTED
Trolls spotted moving in droves from out of the Acatlalco mountain ranges in Squiyles this week. Independent reports from trappers and hunters residing in the countries of both Totezatlan and Somic.
What does this mean? The king of Squiyles has made no public statement as to this bizarre behavior of the mountain trolls.
The movement of the large groups is slow, but it is steady. Local farmers at the foothills of the mountains are growing fearsome of the news. Many have sought preemptive aid from the government. No statements have been released regarding these manners. Independent evacuation plans have been made by the locals impacted most by this.
Rugby’s has its ear close to the ground folks!
STAND OFF
The Kingdoms of Binneth and Squiyles stand off in the gulf as naval troops gather. One shot is all it takes to trigger an all out war, and no side looks like it’s going to back down.
After the Kingdom of Squiyles instituted the draft, Military numbers have been climbing fast! But there are reports of Binneth hiring seafaring mercenaries to increase its naval force. Also reports of a supposed “secret-weapon” have surfaced, what could it be? Trained sharks? Magic cannons? Exploding ammo? Rugby’s Gazette is on the case as always folks! We will keep you updated as this naval standoff continues!
Caption: Illustration of the naval ships preparing for war.
MISSING PERSON
Caption: If you have any information regarding the whereabouts of Rex Sauvage, Please contact the local authorities, or contact Rugby’s Roaming Gazette with information and we will forward it to the appropriate agencies.
Dragon-hunting Paladins attacked and robbed in Thorhofn
MARITIME THEFT
It was just your typical day on the docks when a group of people boarded and stole one of the church of St. Cuthberts vessels this week.
“They fucking blinded me!” Said Worick Dragon-bane, one of the members of the holy group.
“The took our fucking boat while I was napping on it”
“and they FUCKING BLINDED ME”
A chase pursued shortly thereafter, where they found him dropped off on the island of Torta. The same island where the dragons attacks seem to have started.
Their ship had been set ablaze and scuttled near the shore. The pirates were nowhere to be found.
“I plan on finding those vile pirates, nobody messes with the church of St. Cuthbert and gets away with it. Fortunately our watchmen was left alive and saw one of them, a samurai. We can hire mages to divine his location now.
ORCS DEMAND PRISONER
Gorthak demands return of hostage taken in by Binneth Authorities
RETURN ZAKME’D
The demands are in. Garthok has killed an entire Binneth scouting party except one member who was badly mutilated with a message carved into his back. The young military scout was sent home to ‘tell of what he saw” and “Deliver the message to your masters” He made it all the way back to Beisfjord city yesterday before collapsing.
The message carved into the young scouts back read as follows:
RETURN ZAKME’D OR THE DARKNESS WILL FALL ON YOU AS WELL
The young man died shortly thereafter by an infection reaching his bloodstream due to untreated wounds. However he did manage to relay some critical information regarding troops and amounts and kinds of warriors in Gorthaks army.
No statement has been released by the king.
Ad: WE WANT YOU
All Mercenaries welcome
Contact your local recruitment agency
FOR BINNETHS NAVY
NEW PUBLICATIONS WHENEVER WE FEEL LIKE IT!
Canon facts

The church of St. Cuthbert in Holsoy burned down this week, the latest in a series of apparent targeted attacks on churches of St. Cuthbert by dragons.
Corbin Strange is an exotic monsters and animals expert who works with Rugby’s Roaming Gazette.
Rumour (per Corbin Strange): dragons may be targeting the churches out of long-held grudges against crimes the church no longer remembers committing; dragons working together is called unusual since they are normally solitary.
Rex Sauvage is a missing person; the Gazette and local authorities are seeking information on his whereabouts.
Trolls have been sighted moving in large, slow-moving droves out of the Acatlalco mountain range in the Kingdom of Squiyles, reported independently by trappers and hunters in both Totezatlan and Somic.
The King of Squiyles has made no public statement on the troll migration; foothill farmers are growing fearful and some have made independent evacuation plans.
The Kingdoms of Binneth and Squiyles are in a naval standoff in the gulf, with both sides gathering troops; war could be triggered by a single shot.
The Kingdom of Squiyles has instituted a military draft, rapidly increasing its forces.
Rumour: Binneth is hiring seafaring mercenaries and reportedly has a “secret weapon” (speculated to be trained sharks, magic cannons, or exploding ammo — unconfirmed).
A vessel belonging to the Church of St. Cuthbert was stolen from the docks at Thorhofn this week by a group that blinded crew member Worick Dragon-bane, a paladin of the dragon-hunting holy group, while he napped aboard.
The thieves were chased and traced to the island of Torta, the same island where the dragon attacks on churches are believed to have started; their ship was found set ablaze and scuttled near shore, the thieves gone.
A watchman survived the Torta encounter and identified one of the perpetrators as a samurai; the church plans to hire mages to magically divine his location.
The orc leader Garthok (also referred to as “Gorthak” in the subheadline) wiped out an entire Binneth scouting party, sparing and mutilating one member by carving a message into his back: “RETURN ZAKME’D OR THE DARKNESS WILL FALL ON YOU AS WELL.”
Garthok is demanding the return of a hostage named Zakme’d, said to have been taken into custody by Binneth authorities.
The mutilated young scout carried the message back to Beisfjord city, arriving and collapsing before dying shortly after from an untreated-wound infection; he relayed critical intelligence on the troop numbers and warrior types in Garthok’s army before dying.
The King (unnamed, presumably of Binneth) has released no statement regarding the orc demands.
An advertisement is recruiting “All Mercenaries” for Binneth’s Navy via local recruitment agencies.

gazette/2019-06-17.title: 2019-06-17 · Gazette, April 28 4885
gazette/2019-06-17.content:
In the news: places/Kingdom of Squiyles, npcs/King Stroth, places/Howling Gulf,
Paengju, Zakmed, Gorthak, places/Kingdom of Hawkthorne
SHOTS FIRED, WAR COMMENCES
Riots in the streets
CIVIL WAR?
Thousands upon thousands of citizens pour into the streets all over the kingdom. Protests to end the war with Binneth and come to a land agreement with Gorthak are happening all over. In fact while I am writing this very article I can see and hear them right outside the Rugby building here in Conopimalis.
Reports of droves of Squiylian citizens seeking asylum north of the border in Hawkthorne only to be turned away at the border. Families with nothing left are camping out in horrible conditions.
The nation is seeing a small uprising gain traction, one that is pushing toward forming a union of self governing countries. fully separated from King Stroth’s rule.
Many leading figures of the uprising are being arrested for treason. Which is only spreading Stroths reputation for tyranny further and faster.
What does this mean for the future of the kingdom?
Caption: Illustration of a troll destroying a villagers house on it’s way down the mountains
FARMERS SLAIN
Trolls destroying everything in their path
The rural regions of squiyles normally dotted with beautiful cottages and wonderful farms is now a path of wreckage. As trolls hurl chunks of stone villas into everything that gets in their way.
What was a curious movement has quickly become a fearsome attack. and based on movement patterns many believe some sort of deal has been struck between the Orcs and the Trolls to dominate and share the lands that are currently contested.
The strain on the kingdom is greater than ever, panic has spread through the minds and hearts of those nearest the attacks. City officials are attempting to maintain civility and calm citizens, however looting has begun as cities fight the civil unrest that is beginning to plague them.
FIRE LANCES
Binneth’s secret weapon lights up the night
The standoff turned into a bloodbath last night. No one knows who shot first, but everyone knows who shot last.
After cannon fire echoed through the gulf and soldiers sprang to life to fight for flag and country. One thing is certain, no one saw binneth’s secret weapon coming.
Equipped with ‘fire breathing’ ships the fleets performed head on attack maneuvers to evade cannon fire from many of the squiylian ships equipped with side firing guns. The first skirmish lasted all night but nearly half of squiyles ships were burnt to the seafloor.
Caption: Illustration of the fire breathing ships of Binneths navy
BEWARE
Mysterious plant mind controlling those who encounter it
News from the botanical world!
We interviewed our rarely brought into service, in house botanist, Gerome Kudzu Wünderberry for this piece.
In the forests of the massive rainforest island of Paengju there lies many undiscovered species of plants, insects, fungi, animals, and magical beasts.
But this story focuses on what we believe to be a psychic plant that is parasitic in nature. an invasive species that propagates and continues it’s invasion through the hands of psychically enslaved hosts.
We’ve only heard word of this from one who was able to escape from the psionic bonds.
“I toiled in the rainforest caring for this horrid plant for 12 years, It was only during a lightning storm when the plant was struck by lightning that I escaped”
Expeditions are being planned to research this strange plant.
DISAPPEARING ACT
Binneth authorities baffled as to how he disappeared
The Royal guard released a statement two days ago warning the public to be on alert. Zakmed, the captured orc that sparked demands from the Orcish leader Gorthak, has gone missing.
He is considered very dangerous, and we don’t know where he is. Be careful while wandering the streets.
ORC PRISONER MISSING
Earlier in the week it was discovered through the use of the confiscated sending stones that Zakmed is the son of Gorthak.
Zakmeds imprisonment as a Binneth war criminal was an excellent bargaining chip now lost for the Kingdom of Binneth. If you have any information regarding his whereabouts there is a hefty reward being offered by the King to anyone who provides information leading to his re-arrest.
Contact the Royal Guard or City Watch for details
Ad: BOUNTY
Contact the church of St. Cuthbert for reward
₲ 10,000
DEAD OR ALIVE
Canon facts

The Kingdom of Squiyles is at war with Binneth; the kingdom’s capital/seat referenced here is Conopimalis, Erepec, Squiyles (masthead publication line).
King Stroth rules Squiyles; a growing uprising seeks to form a union of self-governing countries separate from his rule, and leading uprising figures are being arrested for treason.
Squiylian refugees are fleeing north to Hawkthorne and being turned away at the border.
Rumour: trolls are rampaging through Squiyles’ rural regions, destroying farms and villas; movement patterns suggest (rumour) a deal between Orcs and Trolls to dominate and share contested lands.
Binneth’s navy possesses “fire breathing” ships, used in a night battle in “the gulf” against Squiylian cannon-armed ships with side-firing guns; nearly half of Squiyles’ ships were destroyed.
The island of Paengju contains a massive rainforest with undiscovered flora, insects, fungi, animals, and magical beasts.
Rumour (single secondhand source): a psychic, parasitic plant on Paengju enslaves hosts psychically to propagate; an escaped caretaker said they tended it for 12 years before a lightning strike on the plant freed them. Research expeditions are being planned.
Zakmed, an orc war criminal held by Binneth, is the son of the Orcish leader Gorthak; this was confirmed via confiscated sending stones.
Zakmed has gone missing/escaped from Binneth custody; the Royal Guard warns he is dangerous and is offering a reward for information leading to his re-arrest.
The Church of St. Cuthbert is offering a bounty of ₲10,000, dead or alive, for an unnamed target (see ad).

gazette/2019-06-24.title: 2019-06-24 · Gazette, May 4 4885
gazette/2019-06-24.content:
In the news: places/Kingdom of Turgyth, npcs/Dr. Joanne Hingbrant,
npcs/Captain Hoolihan, npcs/King Stroth, Bringska,
npcs/Grandmaster Wizard Kirby, places/Novaexum City
SPACE PROGRAM
Astronomers look to science for answers
With advances in oxygen recycling magic. Gnomish Fire propulsion and advances in tin smithing. The kingdom of Turgythe has announced yesterday that they plan to begin the world’s first space program.
That is, a program dedicated to exploring the space between the world as we know it and the heavens occupied by the gods themselves.
The program is being funded by the royal treasury, under the Science and Alchemy research act of 4870. Initiated as a way to drive forward technological and magical pursuits.
“It is something discussed in fairy tales, we plan to make it a reality, to go out there and really see it all for ourselves” Says Dr. Joanne Hingbrant, Lead researcher on the project.
There have been stories of cosmic monsters and treasures. Those involved plan to go where no humanoid has gone before.
SQUIYLES WIZARDS JOIN FIGHT
NO FOOD
Food supply disrupted
With much of the country of Squiyles at war, and most of the male population drafted. Agricultural production for the kingdom has slowed to a crawl.
That coupled with the Orcs occupying much of the farmland to the east. And the trolls ripping through the farms in central Squiyles, means the kingdom is relying on reserves.
Many have begun to starve in their own homes, revolt is a hot topic, but one resting on the minds of the many.
With so many mouths to feed and resources drying up, the whole kingdom lays on a tipping point.
Something must be done, sooner rather than later.
Resolution must come soon or the cost of victory could be the kingdom itself.
GREAT BALLS OF FIRE
Newly arrived on the scene
Fireball after fireball, being heaved by spellslingers, as Squiyles army of special wizard forces takes to the skies!
Folks it’s a sight to behold! Maybe the battle took a turn for the worst last week, but we haven’t seen the last of tricks up King Stroths sleeves!
The night was lit up with magical flames, as ship after ship was burnt to the ground. Binneth’s navy still outnumbers Squiylian ships however with another day’s rest the wizard special forces will surely be at it again to clean up the leftovers!
Caption: Captain Hoolihan, leader of the Wizard Special Forces, Squiyles army.
WALL OF WONDERS
Rainbow color rift opens in town square!
In the small pown of Bringska, Hawkthorne. A rip in reality opened up in the form of a strange colorful wall.
At first those around were scared of this strange phenomenon. But then something happened…
A boy jumped through. Upon exiting the wall he had gained telekinetic powers! Another went through and his pockets began overflowing with jewels and gems!
More and more people of the town began jumping through. It was only after a few jumps they realized not all the gifts the wall bestowed were great.
Someone’s hair all fell out, another began laughing hysterically and uncontrollably. The people began to fear the wall. The last man to enter was pulled through the ground screaming never to be seen again.
The authorities are sealing off the wall in stone and are not allowing anyone else to enter.
IMMORTALITY FAILURE
Thousands watch as Grandmaster Wizard Kirby tears himself apart
CATASTROPHIC FAILURE
During the immortality Lecture 3 days ago at the Novaexum Lecture hall in Novaexum City. Grandmaster wizard Kirby was demonstrating a theoretical spell stacking technique that could render the caster immortal. Members of the audience gathered to see the spectacle of wizarding prowess.
However, disaster struck when Kirby lost control of the spell and compound magical mishaps shattered through him exploding the multiple magical focusing mirrors and astral lenses he was using to amplify his spellwork.
Multiple versions of himself ripped through the mirrors and slammed into him with explosions of blinding light.
Numerous beams of light cascaded from his body and shot in every direction.
There has been no sight of him since.
Caption: Last moments before Kirby’s spell catastrophically failed
Ad: KILL and the Boys
Playing the floating stage at Bruga!
Listen to Metal while you Watch the war!
Dont Miss em!
Canon facts

The Gazette is published out of Conopimalis, Erepec, in the Kingdom of Squiyles. Masthead dated MAY 4 4885.
The kingdom of Turgythe has announced a space program, funded by the royal treasury under the Science and Alchemy research act of 4870; lead researcher is Dr. Joanne Hingbrant.
Squiyles is at war; most of its male population has been drafted, and agricultural production has slowed to a crawl.
Orcs occupy much of the farmland to the east of Squiyles; trolls are destroying farms in central Squiyles.
Squiyles has formed a special wizard air force using fireball attacks against enemy ships; its leader is Captain Hoolihan.
King Stroth is a ruler associated with Squiyles (referenced as “King Stroths sleeves”).
Binneth has a navy that, as of this issue, still outnumbers Squiylian ships.
A rift/wall of strange colorful energy opened in the town square of Bringska, Hawkthorne (a small town). People who passed through gained random effects: telekinetic powers, pockets full of jewels and gems, hair loss, uncontrollable hysterical laughter; one person was pulled through the ground screaming and was never seen again. Authorities have since sealed the wall in stone.
Grandmaster Wizard Kirby, at the Novaexum Lecture Hall in Novaexum City, attempted a theoretical immortality spell-stacking technique during a public lecture 3 days before this issue; the spell catastrophically failed, destroying his focusing mirrors and astral lenses, sending duplicate versions of himself and beams of light through the crowd. Kirby has not been seen since.
“KILL and the Boys” is a band advertised as playing “the floating stage at Bruga.”

gazette/2019-07-15.title: 2019-07-15 · Gazette, May 8 4885
gazette/2019-07-15.content:
In the news: npcs/Rex Sauvage, places/Howling Gulf, Cacoal,
factions/The Changeling Nation, places/Isle of Death, npcs/Than’ Targuhn,
Sawyen, Suenth
NO CORPSE IS SAFE
Grave robbings on the rise!
With eyes looking toward the war, and men away from home and country, fighting dearly for their kingdom. Graves are being ransacked.
That’s right folks, vile graverobber’s seizing the opportunity to steal Nana’s necklace from her resting corpse… Despicable.
So guard your family plots everybody. I for one don’t want to see what time has done to old uncle Earl after his body is left out in the hot sun the next morning, just so a few opportunists can pry his gold teeth from his face.
Crime of all sorts has been on the rise since the draft, One such gang has been gaining traction in the inner city circles. They go by the name the “Dodgers” as they all seem to be draft dodgers cashing in on the lack of civil security as of late.
Lock your doors, Hide your wives.
MAGIC WHIRLPOOLS IN GULF
STILL MISSING
Our dear Rex Sauvage is missing
A couple issues back, we sent out a missing persons ad for our beloved Rex Sauvage, who’s tales of adventure excite and amuse us all. Rex has been a staple submitter here at the paper for many years.
It is very out of character for him to just up and disappear like that. Unfortunately for our scrying attempts, Rex wears an amulet that helps to protect him from location detection and scrying. Our efforts to locate him magically have proved to be fruitless.
If the unthinkable has happened, and we have lost our dear Rex, as is the case sometimes with the most daring of adventurers, we would all like to know how.
If anyone has any information regarding his whereabouts, please come forward. His wife and children are worried sick about him.
MAGICAL DEATH TORANDOES
Which side did they come from!? Who’s in control?
Spotted late last night, a pair of confirmed magical water spouts have been seen forming in the center of the gulf. They are gaining in size and just spiraling about each other.
No one seems to know who is in control! Who is the magical manufacturuer of these watery death bringers??
They can be seen only from some scouting ships who dare to get close enough. but have soared to the whopping size of 300 feet tall and 50 feet wide already. Massive amounts of water in the sky.
Many worry that these beasts will keep growing and form into some sort of magical hurricane attack
DECLARE THEIR COUNTRY
Doppelgangers Come out of the shadows
Amidst the current war torn countryside, news has broken that the entire country of Cacoal has been overrun, overtaken, and now fully being controlled by Doppelgangers.
The Leaders of the doppelgangers just want their country to be recognized as any other nation. This comes as a shock for many. As the slow and roguelike invasion must have costed many lives, many of which are unaccounted for since entry to the country from outsiders is no longer permitted.
“You can’t just steal an entire country, and expect everyone to just be okay with it!” Says Gerard Twombly a man who used to live in Cacoal. “It’s fucking ridiculous is what it is.” “I say we burn the whole damn country to the ground and start again, God damn doppelgangers.”
King Stroth has made no statement regarding the self declared “Changeling Nation”
LAYS WASTE TO ISLAND
“It was a horrifying being with a baren skull and no skin.”
It was a regular night of fishing for Than’ Targuhn when he saw a figure in the sky followed by what must have been a dozen or so others.
A green light flashed and noxious smoke started billowing forth from the figure.
FLESHLESS HORROR
“I barely escaped with my life. the screams, still howling in my brain…”
It is a popular spot for rare large monstrous fish, just East of Sawyen before getting to the Monstrous nation of Suenth.
However few venture into the mysterious island, as huge monsters and dinosaurs are known to roam there.
Locals have now been referring to the island as the ‘Isle of Death’
Caption: Artist’s rendition of the horror
Ad: Golem’s Galore
One stop shop for autonomous animated slaves!
Caption: City of Veset, Lausia, Kingdom of Hawkthorne
Canon facts

This issue of Rugby’s Roaming Gazette is published in Conopimalis, Erepec, Kingdom of Squiyles; masthead dated MAY 8 4885; paper established EST 3865.
Graverobbing is on the rise; a gang called the “Dodgers” (draft dodgers) is gaining traction in inner city circles amid wartime civil security shortages.
Rex Sauvage, a longtime adventure-story submitter to the Gazette, has been missing since a prior issue; he wears an amulet that blocks location detection and scrying, which has frustrated efforts to find him. He has a wife and children.
Two magical waterspouts (“Magical Death Tornadoes”) have appeared in the gulf, growing to roughly 300 feet tall and 50 feet wide, with unknown origin/control; feared to be forming into a magical hurricane.
The country of Cacoal has been overrun and is now controlled by doppelgangers, who have declared it a self-styled “Changeling Nation” and seek recognition as a nation; outsider entry is no longer permitted. Gerard Twombly is a former Cacoal resident quoted objecting to the takeover. King Stroth has made no official statement.
Than’ Targuhn, a fisherman, witnessed a skeletal, skinless flying horror accompanied by roughly a dozen others, with a green light and noxious smoke, near an island east of Sawyen, before the Monstrous nation of Suenth; the area is a popular spot for rare large monstrous fish. Locals now call the island the “Isle of Death” due to monsters and dinosaurs known to roam there.
Advertisement: “Golem’s Galore,” billed as a “one stop shop for autonomous animated slaves,” with artwork captioned as depicting the City of Veset, Lausia, Kingdom of Hawkthorne.

gazette/2019-10-07.title: 2019-10-07 · Gazette, June 1 4885
gazette/2019-10-07.content:
In the news: places/Western Territories, places/Eastern Territories,
places/Orc Lands, places/Troll Mountains, Stogath, places/Howling Gulf,
places/Kingdom of Binneth, places/Kingdom of Turgyth
POST-WAR NATIONS DASH FOR LAND
Eastern and Western Territories declare themselves sovereign
Binneth claims new territory north of its borders!
Weeks after war borders are changing fast
NEW SOVEREIGN NATIONS
With eyes looking toward the future many citizens of the fallen Squiylian kingdom have scrambled to find new homes and declare new houses.
It seems every day there’s a new ‘noble family’ of the territories squabbling for land rights and titles.
Without a proper government, small militias belonging to various wealthy families have begun imposing a litany of new laws most of which conflicting with one another as some sort of semblance of a new government forms.
The laws seem to either be too strict or nonexistant at all, depending on who the offender is.
It is the opinion of the paper that only those who wish to live a wild-west style of living should venture into the territories for the time being.
EXPANSION
Massive movements north of the Binneth border.
There does not seem to be any additional conflicts during the movement however, as if some sort of post-war agreement has been reached to avoid additional losses during the border shifts for various nations.
Binneth has also lifted the trade blockades into the Howling Gulf and struck new deals with nations that used to have tight trade deals with Squiyles, especially those in the potato markets.
What does this mean for the future? It looks like Binneth is on the rise to be one of the worlds great powers, according to our economists here at the Gazette. Quite fortunate for them they lost very little military force during the conflicts of the past month.
CHANGE
Extensive cleanup continues in the fallen ruins of what once was Squiyles.
Empires are experiencing shifts in power dynamics as borders seem to be adjusting post war.
We certainly are living in interesting times folks. So many changes so very fast. Changelings have setup rulership through the majority of what was once Squiyles. Trolls have left the mountain tunnels and are spreading throughout the mountain ranges. Along with the trolls many dangerous beasts have been spotted in these areas.
The landscape is anything but stable out there.
Caption: Map of the continent showing the Western Territories, Eastern Territories, Orc Lands, Troll Mountains, Changelings’ territory, Howling Gulf, and Binneth.
WHIRLPOOL LEAVES TUNNEL BEHIND
Strange hole in gulf seems to open a portal to the unknown
TUNNEL TO HELL?
One of the strangest things leftover from the war looks to be a peculiar hole in the water.
This hole is a calm circular waterfall leading into an abyss. It has nearly no pull like a normal whirlpool. It doesn’t spin like a vortex.
Just a hole. In the middle of the water with water pouring endlessly down it.
It gives off a magical aura and shows no signs of slowing down as its gulping down the gulf!
Rugby’s Gazette reached out to a local fisherman regarding his experience visiting the tunnel in the water.
“We been on da boat here peerin’ down it… look deep ta us”
“Real deep…”
“Paulie said he thought he heard a real deep growl coming from inside”
Fascinating. If one of our readers has the gumption to go check it out, Rugby’s will pay handsomely for a detailed field report, as always.
Currently it looks as though the strange tunnel to nowhere is being avoided by traders and gawked at by tourists who have come to gawk and throw objects down it.
Caption: Artist’s rendition of the tunnel.
Ad: Come and see!
Balthezar’s Bazaar
Traveling carnival of curiosities
Balthezars Bazaar! Located in Pores, Kuria, Kingdom of Turgyth. Every weekend in June!
Rugby’s Gazette has a new home
NEW HEADQUARTERS
Amidst the crumbling cities and power grabs from various kingdoms, houses, and even street gangs.
Rugby’s Gazette had no choice but to leave its home in what was once the great Conopimalis city.
With a heavy heart we say goodbye to the old half destroyed headquarters, but look forward to the future. We have moved to the Western Territories to an island that used to be under Squiylian rule.
Thank you readers for your continued support even during troubled times.
Please submit any future field reports, articles, obituaries, and the like to our new address listed below:
Rugby’s Roaming Gazette
City of Stogath,
Isle of Stogath,
Western Territories
Canon facts

Masthead: Rugby’s Roaming Gazette, EST 3865, published in Stogath, Stogath Isle, Western Territories; this issue dated JUNE 1 4885.
The Squiylian kingdom has fallen; its former territory (“Squiyles”) is in post-war ruins and under cleanup.
Eastern and Western Territories have declared themselves sovereign, post-war.
No central government exists in the territories; various wealthy families’ militias impose conflicting local laws.
The nation of Binneth has claimed new territory north of its border, in what the paper describes as an agreement avoiding additional losses among nations during the border shifts.
Binneth has lifted trade blockades into the Howling Gulf and struck new trade deals with nations that used to trade with Squiyles (including the potato markets).
Binneth lost little military force during the recent war/conflicts and is described (per the Gazette’s economists) as rising to become one of the world’s great powers.
Changelings have set up rulership over the majority of former Squiyles territory.
Trolls have left the mountain tunnels and are spreading throughout the mountain ranges, along with other dangerous beasts now spotted in those areas.
Map locations named: Western Territories, Eastern Territories, Orc Lands, Troll Mountains, Changelings’ territory, Howling Gulf, Binneth.
A strange magical hole/tunnel has appeared in the Howling Gulf where a whirlpool used to be: a calm, circular, non-spinning waterfall pouring endlessly into an abyss, giving off a magical aura and showing no sign of slowing.
A local fisherman (quoted, name not given) and his companion “Paulie” visited the tunnel by boat; Paulie reported hearing what he thought was a deep growl coming from inside it.
Rugby’s Gazette is offering payment for a detailed field report from any reader willing to investigate the tunnel.
Traders are currently avoiding the tunnel; tourists gather to gawk at it and throw objects down it.
Rugby’s Roaming Gazette has relocated its headquarters: its old office (described as half-destroyed) was in the once-great city of Conopimalis; its new headquarters is on an island in the Western Territories that used to be under Squiylian rule, address given as “City of Stogath, Isle of Stogath, Western Territories.”
Advertisement: Balthezar’s Bazaar, a traveling carnival of curiosities, located in Pores, Kuria, Kingdom of Turgyth, running every weekend in June.
Rumour/unverified: the growl Paulie reported hearing from inside the tunnel is only his impression, not confirmed.

gazette/2020-04-13.title: 2020-04-13 · Gazette, July 4 4885
gazette/2020-04-13.content:
In the news: Sawyen, Suenth, Meschen,
places/Kingdom of Binneth, places/Orc Lands, places/Kingdom of Hawkthorne,
npcs/Rex Sauvage, Desna
Unseen and Unheard
Changelings remain quiet during death cloud panic
With closed borders and tight lips. Part of the stolen land that once belonged to the proud nation of Squiyles is silent.
Their silence began over a month ago when they declared themselves a ruling power. Since that declaration there has been no word.
Now during these trying times, with the impending death cloud all we here is the same.
Silence.
All trade has also ceased since the initial declaration. What does this mean for those who are migrating west toward those closed borders?
Swaths of people with nowhere to go are moving west away from the ravages of the miasmic cloud. What will happen when they arrive in land that is no forbidden to be on?
Only time will tell.
Miasmic Cloud Spreading Fast
Evacuation
Any and all! You must get out! and fast!
Folks! Seek safe territory! the cloud has swallowed the eastern portions of Binneth, the orclands, and Hawkthorne!
Underground bunkers are being constructed as initial tests suggest that the cloud has difficulty penetrating the soil.
Makeshift ventilation units are being cobbled together with makeshift mechanical and magic ferver.
It’s messy out there, governments are opening borders, then closing borders. Announcements are being made on how to handle the impending cloud that differ from day to day and hour to hour.
Get out! Go! Stop reading this! for the love of Desna get the hell to safety!
Death Cloud
Miasmic cloud swallowing up land and moving fast
From the shores of Sawyen and Suenth a green cloud of deathly energy is eminating outward. Each day observers are noticing it reaches further and further. Reports of many ocean vessels not returning from the ara as well.
“There was a big ol’ green light.. and then just bones were thar after my brother jumped throu’it” Says Buckley. a fisherman who awoke to see the cloud creeping toward the vessel he was crewing on.
We received multiple reports of pulsing bright spots of energy in the distance in the cloud. No one that we know of has entered the cloud successfully that we know of.
Caption: Artist’s rendition of the miasmic death cloud
Forgotten Town Dies to Miasma
Lost to Time
Isolated town meets outsiders, refuses to evacuate
During the evacuations of surviving portions of Suenth and Sawyen. Small Islands surrounding the countries needed to be evacuated as well.
a small mountain village calling themselves Meschen was discovered. The party of volunteers struggled with the locals to get them to understand the threat that was heading toward them. It was to no avail.
The following was stated by the leader of the mission:
“They showered us with a feast of potatoes…
We told them there wasn’t much time and it wasn’t time for french fries or potato salad.”
“Their culture was tied to the mountain. They lived here and grew up here. They had only seen one group of newcomers before us”
“When we tried to describe what was heading toward them they had no concept of what we were telling them.
Short of forcefully capturing them and binding them to remove them from the island we were out of options.
We left them to their fate, they did however gift many gifts from their town.”
Caption: Artist’s rendition of the attempted rescue of the lost town of Meschen
Swashbuckler Story Tellers
Rugby’s Gazette needs a new field journalist
Amidst the terror and torment that afflicts this world on the daily. We know there are travellers with tales to spill.
With the disappearance of our dearest and most respected journalist Rex Sauvage, a hole has been left here at the gazette.
Will you be the one to fill our hole?
Can you dash through flames and brighted the hearts of our readers?
Do you seek thrills and make the tales that bards weave into song for centuries?
Are you a dashing handsome explorer who needs a soapbox?
The readers at Rugbys Gazette need your talent!
Show it off, we pay very well for good quality submissions.
Ad: Community And Private Miasmic Cloud Fallout Shelters!
Caption: Lee’s Impending Doom Solutions — Located in Yosari, Kaku, Kingdom of Gaithiyre
Canon facts

Published by Rugby’s Roaming Gazette, est. 3865, out of Stogath, Stogath Isle, Western Territories.
This issue dated JULY 4 4885.
The nation of Squiyles declared itself a ruling power roughly a month before this issue, closed its borders, and has issued no further word since; all trade with it has ceased.
A miasmic “death cloud” — a green cloud of deathly energy — is spreading outward from the shores of Sawyen and Suenth, swallowing eastern portions of Binneth, the orclands, and Hawkthorne.
Ocean vessels near the cloud have failed to return; a fisherman named Buckley reports witnessing a green light and his brother reduced to bones after jumping through it.
Governments are constructing underground bunkers as shelter, since the cloud reportedly has difficulty penetrating soil; ventilation units are being improvised with combined mechanical and magical means.
A small mountain village called Meschen, isolated and previously having met only one other group of outsiders, was discovered during evacuations of Suenth/Sawyen’s surrounding islands; its people refused to believe in or evacuate from the miasmic threat and were left behind, after gifting the rescue party goods.
The Gazette’s previous field journalist, Rex Sauvage, has disappeared; the paper is soliciting a new field journalist/storyteller.
Advertisement: “Lee’s Impending Doom Solutions,” a miasmic cloud fallout shelter business (ventilation, water, food, communication), located in Yosari, Kaku, Kingdom of Gaithiyre.
Rumour: multiple reports describe pulsing bright spots of energy visible within the cloud at a distance; no one is known to have entered the cloud and returned.

gazette/2022-12-18.title: 2022-12-18 · Gazette, June 7 4885
gazette/2022-12-18.content:
In the news: factions/The Changeling Nation, places/Troll Mountains,
places/Kingdom of Hawkthorne, Narfuuuk, places/Balnaskor Mountains,
npcs/Timothy Mantooth, npcs/Rex Sauvage, places/Drang City
THE WAR IS OVER BUT WHAT’S NEXT?
In the aftermath of war, the future of Squiyles remains uncertain
As the cleanup efforts continue in the aftermath of the war, changes in power dynamics among the various empires are becoming more apparent. The changelings, who have taken over the majority of what was once Squiyles, are now ruling over the area with an iron fist.
Trolls, who were previously confined to the mountain tunnels, have begun to spread throughout the mountain ranges. This has led to increased sightings of dangerous beasts in these areas, causing concern among the local populations.
“It’s a very unsettling time for all of us,” said one local resident. “The trolls and their beasts are causing havoc in the mountains, and it’s only a matter of time before they start encroaching on our lands. We’re all just trying to stay safe and protect what’s ours.”
The unstable landscape has prompted many to call for increased border protections and stricter enforcement of laws in order to maintain some sense of order in the region.
However, with so many empires vying for power, it remains to be seen how this will all play out.
“These truly are interesting times,” said one political analyst. “It’s anyone’s guess how things will ultimately shake out, but one thing is for certain: the future of Squiyles, and the surrounding areas, is far from certain.”
Despite the challenges facing the region, the changeling rulers of what was once Squiyles remain confident in their ability to maintain control. In a recent statement, the changeling leader declared, “We will not be intimidated by the trolls and their beasts. We will continue to uphold the laws and protect our borders to ensure the safety and security of our people.”
INTERNATIONAL PEACE MEETING
Doppelgangers to hold international summit
PEACE MEETINGS
Doppelgangers are gathering in the capital city of Squiyles for an international peace conference. The changeling rulers, who have taken control of the city following the recent war, are hosting the event in an effort to promote diplomacy and cooperation with other kingdoms. Representatives from several major empires are expected to attend, including the powerful goblin kingdom of Hawkthorne. The conference is being closely monitored by the international community, as the changelings are hopeful that it will pave the way for a more peaceful and stable future. Representatives from Gaithyre, McCathlyre, and Turgythe have been requested to be in attendance.
Caption: Artist rendition of the anticipated international peace summit
KIDNAPPING NEAR BALNASKOR
Family run inn of goblins are brokenhearted
SLAVERS ON THE RUN
‘Narfuuuk’, a wealthy goblin noble, has placed a bounty of 10,000 gold pieces for the safe return of his nephew, who was recently kidnapped from the family-run inn in Balneskor.
According to witnesses, the goblin was seen being handcuffed with manacles by a group of adventurers who were heading into the mountains, where it is believed they may be operating as slavers.
The kidnappers are considered armed and dangerous, and locals are advised to avoid any confrontations with them.
“It was just so sad to see,” said one witness, who wished to remain anonymous. “The goblin was struggling and crying out for help, but the adventurers just ignored him and continued on their way.”
The family of the kidnapped goblin is devastated by the loss, and are urging anyone with information to come forward. “We just want our loved one back safe and sound,” said the innkeeper, who is also the goblin’s uncle. “We are willing to pay whatever it takes to get him back.”
Caption: Artist’s rendition of the kidnapped victim
FIELD REPORT
The Daring Timothy Mantooth
As I venture into the snowy regions of the Balnaskor Mountains, I am filled with excitement and a sense of adventure.
I am standing on the shoulders of a giant, my hero, Rex Sauvage, who was tragically killed while on a field report in the orc lands. I am determined to continue his legacy and to shed light on the often misunderstood world of the orcs and their customs.
Despite the challenges posed by the harsh mountain environment, I have already made some fascinating discoveries. The sparse snow dwelling local orc clans have shared with me stories of encounters with these creatures, and I have even heard there is a mysterious mountain town enveloped in an inescapable fog.
I will continue to brave the elements and explore these frozen lands, and will keep you updated on my progress. Until next time, this is Timothy Mantooth, signing off.
Ad: Blanchet’s Botany
Carnivorous Plants
Bonsai Treefolk Pets
Exotics and Plant derived toxins
Located in Town Square
Drang City, Ingenia
Kingdom of Hawkthorne

Magical Superstore, no other selection like it in the Kingdom

PEACE SUMMIT RESULTS IN CHAOS
To everyone’s surprise, Doppelganger peace summit ends badly
CHAOS SUMMIT
The peace summit in Squiyles has ended in disaster, as it was revealed that several of the changeling representatives had used their shapeshifting abilities to infiltrate and assume the identities of other attendees.
As the conference devolved into chaos and violence, it became clear that some of the changelings present had taken on the forms of other rulers and diplomats in an attempt to influence the proceedings in their favor.
The revelation caused outrage among the other attendees, who accused the changelings of deceit and manipulation.

In the aftermath of the summit, it is uncertain how relations between the various empires will be affected, and many fear that the breakdown of the peace conference could lead to further mistrust and hostility in the future.

gazette/2023-09-24.title: 2023-09-24 · Gazette, Dec 19 4885
gazette/2023-09-24.content:
In the news: quests/Win the Magic Carpet Race, Lutathal,
places/Troll Mountains, Godoy, Cadillac, npcs/Ray Parker,
places/Western Territories
TROLL TINCTURE SAVES TERRITORIES
No-Holds-Barred Mayhem on the Horizon
DEATH RACE
Brace yourselves for a heart-pounding spectacle like no other - the Death-Defying “Rugmandella” Race is back! Magicians and daredevils from every corner of the world are invited to test their mettle in the most ruthless competition imaginable. Forget rules and regulations; this is an all-out, no-holds-barred death race where contestants will go head-to-head in a winner-takes-all frenzy. And here’s the kicker - there will be no repercussions for any crimes committed against fellow participants during this merciless event.
For centuries, magic carpets have been coveted for their mystical allure, but now, they’re about to become instruments of chaos and mayhem as they take center stage in the Death-Defying “Rugmandella” Race. This year’s grand prize? The coveted “Rugmandella,” the most menacing, tricked-out magic carpet ever crafted, courtesy of the infamous Carpet Baggers Industries.
The “Rugmandella” boasts enhanced speed, a spellproof chassis, and a sinister arsenal of offensive enchantments, making it the weapon of choice for those who dare to enter the cutthroat world of this death race. And the competition is fierce, as magicians and thrill-seekers alike are drawn to the allure of power, prestige, and chaos.
But it’s not just the enchanted obstacles contestants will need to overcome; it’s each other. This race is no mere competition; it’s a life-and-death struggle where participants will stop at nothing to cross the finish line first. In this ruthless free-for-all, magic is not a tool for harmony but a weapon of destruction, and alliances are made only to be broken.
Entrants must register at their city council before the end of the week. Race begins in Lauvog, in the Western territories.
NEW WEAPON
Alchemists search of poison never fails to astound!
In a groundbreaking development, alchemists have achieved a scientific breakthrough that promises to bring an end to the reign of terror imposed by trolls in the mountainous regions. The newly devised compound, transmitted through troll copulation, has the remarkable ability to permanently alter the trolls’ DNA, rendering them vulnerable upon death without the need for incendiary measures. This discovery raises hopes that troll attacks, which have long plagued the region, will soon dwindle, paving the way for civilized control of the mountains.
With the advent of this alchemical marvel, a fundamental shift in the balance of power is on the horizon. No longer will trolls possess the regenerative capabilities that have made them formidable adversaries. Instead, their numbers are expected to plummet, marking a significant turning point in the struggle for dominance in these rugged landscapes.
Caption: Artist rendition of the anticipated Troll vaccine outcome
BANK UNDER LOCK AND KEY
Godoy, a city celebrated for its serenity, faces a critical shortage of guards as a rigorous vetting process seeks to ensure only the most capable individuals protect the city. Amidst this crisis, a true hero has arisen in the form of Captain Cadillac Huggins, a revered officer who has dedicated himself to safeguarding the city, including its most critical asset - the bank. Captain Steele’s exceptional commitment has been vital in these challenging times.
Godoy’s stringent vetting process, though essential for the city’s safety, has inadvertently created a personnel shortfall, putting a tremendous burden on those entrusted with preserving order and security.
The process, designed to meticulously assess applicants’ backgrounds and character, has proven effective in eliminating potential threats. However, it has also resulted in a dearth of personnel, leaving many posts unfilled.
In the midst of this crisis, Captain Darian Steele has become a symbol of unwavering dedication. With a career spanning decades, Steele is a revered figure within Godoy’s law enforcement community, earning the respect and admiration of both his colleagues and the community at large.
Ad: Sycophancy Scrolls
Scroll mortality rate 50%
Cool staves
Get your familiar appraised
Located in Town Square
Godoy City, Acatlalco
Western Territories
FIELD REPORT
Article from Ray Parker
One night in our shadowy city, I spotted a sight that sent chills down my spine - a medium-sized vessel, like no other ship. It darted through the night sky beneath a shroud of clouds, echoing with tormented tempests.
This airship was a creature of the night, vanishing by dawn. It left no trace, no records of its arrivals or departures. It was as if it had materialized from thin air.
I’m Ray Parker, no stranger to the strange in this city. This case has a hold on me. As I continue my covert investigation, I’m driven by one thing - the need to uncover the truth, buried deep in the shadows.
Ad: Ram & The Fence
Barber and Pawn Shop
Cutting hair and prices
★ Wands work 50% of the time
★ Sleek & Stylish
★ You’ll fawn over what we have in our stables

NEW PUBLICATIONS WHENEVER WE FEEL LIKE IT!
Canon facts

The Gazette is published out of Stogath, Stogath Isle, Western Territories; this issue is dated DEC 19 4885.
The Death-Defying “Rugmandella” Race is a magic-carpet death race with no repercussions for crimes committed against fellow participants; grand prize is the “Rugmandella,” a magic carpet crafted by Carpet Baggers Industries.
Entrants for the Rugmandella Race must register at their city council by end of week; the race begins in Lauvog, in the Western territories.
Alchemists have devised a compound transmitted through troll copulation that alters troll DNA, making trolls vulnerable upon death without incendiary measures - intended to reduce troll attacks in the mountainous regions.
The city of Godoy has a critical shortage of guards due to a strict vetting process for protecting the city and its bank.
Captain Cadillac Huggins is a Godoy officer dedicated to safeguarding the city, including the bank.
Captain Darian Steele is a long-serving, respected Godoy law enforcement officer.
Rumour/unconfirmed sighting: Ray Parker, an investigator in Godoy, reports a mysterious unmarked airship seen at night over the city that leaves no trace and has no recorded arrivals or departures.
Sycophancy Scrolls is a shop in Town Square, Godoy City, Acatlalco, Western Territories, selling scrolls, staves, and familiar appraisals (advertised “scroll mortality rate 50%”).
Ram & The Fence is a barber and pawn shop in Town Square, Godoy City, Acatlalco, Western Territories (advertised “wands work 50% of the time”).

gods/desna.title: Desna
gods/desna.content:
A goddess whose church offers healing and limb regeneration. The only deity explicitly named anywhere
in the 15 issues of Rugby’s Roaming Gazette — no other pantheon members are named in the surviving
issues.
History

The Church of Desna in Conopimalis advertises clerics who perform limb regeneration and general
healing, “whether it’s just a scratch or a full on limb regeneration” 2019-04-01.
Invoked as an oath/plea (“for the love of Desna”) during the Gazette’s frantic evacuation notice for
the spreading miasmic death cloud, suggesting the name is in common enough use as an exclamation
2020-04-13.

gods/pelor.title: Pelor
gods/pelor.content:
Also heard as: Pale Lore, Paylor, Baylor
A sun/light-aligned deity of holy justice, chosen by Jake as “the deity of your choice” at the moment
his character Tick-Tick dies and is reborn a Paladin. Maintains a far-off church whose paladins are
knighted in elaborate ceremonies and marked with Pelor’s sunburst symbol.
History

Jake, communing with a deity as he dies holding the cursed Apocalypse Box, chooses Pelor; his body
dissolves and reforms as an armored Paladin of Pelor wielding a golden scythe marked with Pelor’s
symbol on the scythe, chest piece, and pauldrons 2020-03-24
@ 02:38:22, @ 02:39:17.
As the newly-reborn Paladin, snaps his holy symbol from his neck and banishes the demon possessing
Nutty in a blinding light 2020-03-24 @ 02:41:46,
@ 02:42:10.
Pelor reveals to Jake, during the commune, that the demon had been lurking inside the soul gem Nutty
touched sessions earlier 2020-03-24 @ 02:42:49–02:43:41.
Jake notes Pelor “had to make a deal” to help him come back, suggesting the resurrection carried some
cost or bargain, though it’s never detailed 2020-03-24
@ 02:45:13.
A far-off church of Pelor holds a lavish knighting ceremony for the paladin “Fiend Slayer”
(Sir Holton Albright); the officiating priest recognizes the symbol of Pelor on Tick-Tick’s armor
and welcomes him in 2020-04-13 @ 01:36:34–01:41:15,
@ 01:39:39.

Unresolved
Jake’s in-the-moment phrasing briefly floats Bahamut as an alternative choice of deity before settling on
Pelor “based on my own revenge” — not clarified whether this reflects genuine indecision or just banter
2020-03-24 @ 02:45:18. The nature of Pelor’s
“deal” to resurrect Jake/Tick-Tick is never explained on mic.

index.title: Rugby's Roaming Wiki
index.content:
The canon of Rugby’s Roaming Campaign, rebuilt from 26 recorded sessions (2019–2025) and 15 issues of Rugby’s Roaming Gazette. Every fact links back to the session and timestamp, or the Gazette issue, it came from.
The sessions were transcribed by machine from the table audio, so names are sometimes misheard; each page lists the variants it was heard as.

items/apocalypse-box.title: Apocalypse Box
items/apocalypse-box.content:
A small black wooden box, the third major artifact the party stumbles into during Arc I. Once per day its
bearer can pull one non-magical item from it, but there’s a 50% chance of instead unleashing horrific
monsters that linger for about a week. Can only be destroyed by having its bearer survive three waves of
its summoned monsters and then tricking a gold dragon into crushing it (which kills the dragon too).
History

Conjured into Ozan’s hands by a near-maximum d1000 Whimsy Wall roll
2020-03-16 @ 00:18:15.
Everyone who examines it must make a DC 30 will save; Jake fails and is magically compelled to seize and
guard it from everyone else, including by violence
2020-03-16 @ 00:21:18–00:27:47.
Ozan identifies it via a knowledge check as the legendary Apocalypse Box and explains its powers before
ceding it to Jake 2020-03-16 @ 00:28:35.
Two openings nearly summon six Shoggoths each (CR19) before a third reroll produces a bottle of scotch
instead 2020-03-16 @ 00:41:19–00:43:48.
Donnie reveals the destruction method: three survived monster-waves, then a gold dragon crushing it
2020-03-16 @ 00:44:54.
Jake’s compulsion to open it daily, under an increasingly hard will save, becomes a life-threatening
crisis; the party considers killing him to stop it
2020-03-24 @ 00:30:49–00:39:46.
The curse ends when Jake dies and is reborn a Paladin of Pelor — he is “no longer compelled to
carry/open the Apocalypse Box” 2020-03-24
@ 02:39:50.
Deliberately left unexamined and forgotten in someone’s bag going forward
2020-03-25 @ 02:45:46.
Jake dares Pat (the DM, in-game as a bit) to open it; it turns out to contain only Pat’s own wallet, a
joke 2020-04-13 @ 01:25:49.

Unresolved
The box itself is never destroyed — only its curse on its bearer is lifted. Its ultimate fate is not
addressed again in the recorded sessions.

items/boots-of-haste.title: Boots of Haste
items/boots-of-haste.content:
Enchanted boots granting 6th-level haste once per week.
History

Gained: looted by Rich’s Monk (DungeonVice) from the slain Fugly (killed by Nutty; nicknamed
“the captain” mid-fight — see The Guard Captain) 2025-03-31 @ 02:48:42,
identified as Boots of Haste @ 02:49:34.
Used: Rich activates the boots and goes ethereal to fly after the Boot’s departing ship
2025-03-31 @ 02:58:23-03:02:43, spotting the Boot himself as he flies
through the warehouse @ 03:09:40-03:10:13.

items/dyson-dynamo.title: Dyson Dynamo
items/dyson-dynamo.content:
Also heard as: the dynamic dominum, the Dynamo, the device, soul-storing cylinder, the turbine
A bronze, diamond-shaped artifact built by “a mad scientist” that harvests “just and unjust souls” to
grow in power, crosses planes, and reacts unpredictably to strong magical damage. Gained: bank vault,
episode 1. Used: triggered a citywide firestorm, episode 4. Lost: never — the party still carries it as
of episode 6, now hunted by the TIU.
History

Named as the heist’s target in the vault, “the dynamic dominum”; glimpsed being hauled toward the bank
by giant burrowing creatures 2023-09-12 @ 02:17:01,
@ 04:15:29.
Found in the vault chest as a glowing blue orb, confirmed via Knowledge Arcana to match the mission’s
target 2023-10-01 @ 03:59:31–03:59:37.
Dropped by its doppelganger carrier when killed by Nutty; charged with captured souls from the bank
heist, it reacts to Pat’s ongoing fire-spell damage by rolling to “react” and, on a near-maximum result,
mirrors the spell across the entire city of Godoy, killing roughly 90% of the population
2023-10-15 @ 00:36:05, @ 00:56:37–00:56:59.
Examined drained, warm to the touch, one valve open; Ozan’s knowledge-planes check says it exists on
another plane as well, and Jess’s follow-up planes/arcana/engineering check (a 30, explicitly “not a
natural 20”) confirms it’s crossed planes, likely siphoning souls elsewhere
2023-10-24 @ 00:19:10–00:22:38.
Hunted by TIU investigators, who identify it as the “Dyson Dynamo” and warn it “could unravel the
fabric of reality”; Donnie’s bluff denying any knowledge of it doesn’t sway Thornshade, who marks the
party as suspects regardless 2023-11-28
@ 00:37:54–00:40:15.

Unresolved
Whether “the dynamic dominum” (episode 1), “the Dynamo”/“the device” (episodes 2, 4–5), and the “Dyson
Dynamo” (episode 6) are definitively the same artifact is implied by plot continuity but never restated
explicitly in a single session.

items/folding-boat-nessie.title: Folding Boat Nessie
items/folding-boat-nessie.content:
Also heard as: Nessie, the folding boat
Jess’s folding boat, a box that transforms via command word into a 10-ft rowboat or a 24-ft ship with
cabin, mast, and sail (holds 15). Gained: already owned by Jess’s character before episode 1 (a recurring
item across her characters, per her own running joke). Used: river mooring/shelter and air travel out of
Godoy, episode 5.
History

Jess jokes that she’s gotten a folding boat “a couple times” before and never used it — implying it’s a
pre-existing character item rather than a reward won this session; a separate whimsy-table roll taken
around the same time turns her into a weasel instead
2023-09-12 @ 01:57:49, @ 02:20:47.
Unfolded on land near the riverbank into full ship form (cabin, anchor) as an overnight shelter for the
refugee party, then floated out onto the river; named “Nessie” when Ozan asks for the boat’s name
2023-10-24 @ 00:43:07–00:45:49.
Flown roughly twelve hours to Lutathal after Pat casts Fly on it and hands control to his familiar,
Randy @ 01:04:35–01:17:11.

items/golden-ticket-to-the-devil.title: Golden Ticket to the Devil
items/golden-ticket-to-the-devil.content:
Also heard as: the golden ticket, the platinum ticket
A one-way pass to the devil holding Riggs’s soul, hidden in a locker and sought by Riggs’s Widow.
Not retrieved by anyone during session 3.
History

Described by Riggs’s Widow as her goal in engineering her own capture
2025-03-31 @ 00:19:45, @ 00:20:31.

Unresolved
The ticket’s location, beyond “a locker,” and who currently holds it are unknown; see
Retrieve the Golden Ticket (quest).

items/locate-portal-sextant.title: Locate Portal Sextant
items/locate-portal-sextant.content:
Also heard as: the seven-jewel sextant, the magic sextant
A brass, sextant-like “locate portal” device found in Arc II’s cult complex, with seven glass-marble
slots. Each installed jewel permanently tracks the location of a linked Nexus portal. Distinct from the
unrelated Arc I Planar Sextant aboard the party’s ship.
History

Found by Jess in a desk drawer in the sealed Nexus-portal room, with only one of seven jewel slots
filled 2021-10-19 @ 01:25:33.
Identified by Rich as a permanent locate-portal device needing seven jewels total
2021-10-19 @ 02:39:05.
A new red gem, suspected to key a fiery plane, is recovered from a glowing flag on the frost giant’s
mountaintop 2021-11-02 @ 02:03:16.
Confirmed unable to get the party back out of the Nexus — they must advance through the chain of
gem-keyed portals instead 2021-11-02 @ 02:30:02.

Unresolved
How many of the seven jewel slots remain to be filled, and what plane each corresponds to, is unresolved
at the end of the recorded sessions.

items/maka.title: Maka
items/maka.content:
Also heard as: Rama (possible same drug)
The drug flooding Turgeth, secretly supplied by the College of Turgeth rather than street
dealers, worth roughly 75,000 gold a week.
History

Revealed by Riggs’s Widow to be secretly supplied by the College of Turgeth
2025-03-31 @ 00:24:08, @ 00:24:19.
An earlier mention of a street drug called “Rama” may refer to the same drug, misheard
2025-03-31 @ 00:43:47.

Unresolved
Whether “Maka” and “Rama” are the same drug heard two different ways, or two distinct drugs, is unclear.

items/nutty's-tail-weapon.title: Nutty's Tail Weapon
items/nutty's-tail-weapon.content:
Nutty’s Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice)‘s bladed tail, treated mechanically as a scimitar for an extra
attack.
History

Jake reminds Nutty the weapon exists, having been forgotten about
2025-03-31 @ 01:28:59.
Used to finish off Fugly in combination with a shocking-grasp touch attack (“Washashaka”)
2025-03-31 @ 02:46:05-02:48:22.

items/planar-sextant.title: Planar Sextant
items/planar-sextant.content:
Also heard as: the ship's sextant, the nine-setting device
A rare, touch-activated planar navigation device recovered aboard the looted ship, paired with a
gold-bound crystal that performs the actual plane shift. Nine discrete settings; the party never fully
mapped what each one does. Distinct from the later, unrelated Locate Portal Sextant found in Arc II.
History

Found in the ship’s helm room alongside a gold-bound crystal emanating conjuration/divination magic
2020-01-20 @ 00:17:25–00:33:43.
Donnie touches the crystal directly while experimenting with the sextant’s settings, triggering an
accidental plane shift 2020-01-20 @ 01:02:51.
Position 7 is established as triggering plane travel when the crystal is touched (with a helmet),
powered by blood sacrifice; position 9 shows an unrecognized blinking symbol
2020-01-28 @ 03:40:30.
Activates on its own overnight, dragging the ship into the first layer of the Abyss
2020-01-28 @ 03:40:30–03:45:48.
Donnie resets the navigation settings from memory to jump the ship out of Hell, landing the party in the
Feywild instead of home 2020-03-25 @ 02:31:40–02:36:13.

Unresolved
The exact mapping of settings 1–6 and 8 was never established in play; the mechanism by which the crystal
activated itself unprompted is not explained.

items/revelation-crystals.title: Revelation Crystals
items/revelation-crystals.content:
A pair of gems offered by a skeleton child in a shared dream, which reveal hidden truths; each left a
brand on the back of its recipient’s hand. Appears only in the Pat-DM’d interlude session; see
2023-10-08 and jakedm Unresolved.
History

Offered to and accepted by Jace Gandolfini and Sarkhan Vol in a shared nightmare
2023-10-08 @ 01:55:54–01:57:33.
Sarkhan uses his to dispel the cursed Tomb of Horrors map’s illusion @ 02:01:41.

items/ring-of-protection-+1.title: Ring of Protection +1
items/ring-of-protection-+1.content:
A ring granting +1 AC.
History

Gained/given: Nutty’s Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice) gives this ring to Ozone, raising his AC
2025-03-31 @ 03:19:55.

Unresolved
Where Nutty’s character originally got the ring is not stated.

items/ring-of-the-hive-mind.title: Ring of the Hive Mind
items/ring-of-the-hive-mind.content:
A magical signet ring that telepathically links wearers to a hive mind’s shared knowledge and senses,
while the wearer is conscious.
History

Taken off an unconscious intruder caught breaking into the party’s ship by Jake
2020-01-20 @ 00:01:12.
Identified by Nutty with a natural 20 Knowledge: Arcana check
2020-01-20 @ 00:04:19.

Unresolved
Who else is connected to the hive mind, or whether they’re now aware the party has one of their members’
rings, is never addressed.
Exactly when/how the ring ends up with Nutty is unclear. The timestamp previously cited here
(@ 01:01:12 in 2020-01-20) is actually an
unrelated scene (the party experimenting with the ship’s planar crystal/sextant) — no “hands it to Nutty”
moment was found near that timestamp, or elsewhere in the session. Nutty is the one who identifies the
ring with a natural 20 Knowledge: Arcana check, which may be the source of the assumption that he kept it.

items/sun-sword.title: Sun Sword
items/sun-sword.content:
Also heard as: Dawnblade, the shapeshifting sword
A legendary magic longsword, +3 and dealing bonus damage against vampires and undead within 30 feet.
Shapeshifts into whatever weapon its wielder imagines. Its blade and hilt were deliberately separated long
ago by a powerful magician trying to destroy it; only the blade has been recovered, and the campaign ends
with the hilt still lost.
History

Found as an unidentified shapeshifting sword lying in the middle of an active fire trap in the flooded
basement; Jake braves the flames to claim it, and it takes the form of a glowing blue
rapier when he imagines one
2022-12-26 @ 03:58:19–03:59:58.
Used to pry open Strahd’s coffin, referred to in the moment as “Dawnblade”
2023-02-12 @ 00:42:03.
Found buried with Sergei von Zarovich’s body in the catacombs is a second piece: the Sun Sword’s own
blade, alongside magic armor 2023-01-30 @ 03:53:07–03:54:21.
A Spellcraft check identifies the sword Jake has been carrying since the gas-trap
session as the Sun Sword’s blade — +3 vs. undead with 10 bonus damage vs. vampires within 30 feet — but
confirms its hilt was separated from the blade long ago and remains lost
2023-01-30 @ 04:10:16.

Unresolved
Whether the “shapeshifting sword” found in the fire trap and the blade found in Sergei’s crypt are
literally the same physical object, or two related pieces, is not entirely disentangled in the notes —
both are identified as “the Sun Sword’s blade” by the piss-coat session, and Jake is the one carrying it
throughout. The sword’s hilt is never found in the recorded sessions.

items/tome-of-strahd.title: Tome of Strahd
items/tome-of-strahd.content:
Also heard as: Journal of Strahd
A cursed, dark-magic-laced grimoire — Strahd von Zarovich’s own journal of poems, stories, and diary
entries — said to grant power to readers but risk madness. Contains several torn-out pages.
History

Found hidden under the mattress in Strahd’s personal chamber; identified by Xarthax via Knowledge
(History) as a dangerous, sought-after artifact. Xarthax reads the (safe) early pages
2022-12-18 @ 02:09:47–02:17:02.
Its missing, torn-out pages are flagged by Xarthax as valuable/dangerous and worth hunting down — never
pursued in the recorded sessions
2022-12-18 @ 02:41:23–02:41:54.
Stolen from the party (last carried by Donnie/Donovan) when an earlier, less lethal group of
ghosts captures and ages the party instead of killing them
