sessions/2019-10-15-the-gang-completes-t.title: 2019-10-15 · The Gang Completes the Tests of the Pharaoh
sessions/2019-10-15-the-gang-completes-t.content:
Recap
The party pushes through the pyramid’s “Tests of the Pharaoh”: a twin-door corridor warning of “the doom
of power and evil from a heartless man,” a clay golem that splits when cut (destroyed by shoving both
copies into a water channel), and a wall-of-fire trap on a water-channel staircase. Rich is swept away
alone underwater and meets a sphinx-like creature, Andrew, who offers knowledge for a solved riddle;
Rich stalls and leaves without answering. The party finds an illusory stone wall hiding the way on, then
is ambushed by five shadow “Nega” doubles of themselves. Beyond them sits The Seated Man, apparent
source of the visions that drew the party here — he wakes hostile when Rich tries to steal his staff, and
the session ends mid-fight, badly wounded, as Jake has to leave. The party reaches level 9.
Key events

Twin locked doors inscribed with a warning open onto a clay golem guardian; splitting it only
multiplies it, so it’s shoved into the water channel instead
2019-10-15 @ 00:41:26.
Rich triggers a wall-of-fire trap, dives underwater to bypass it, and is swept alone into a hidden
chamber where he meets Andrew @ 01:13:40.
The party finds an illusory stone wall (wrong material, caught by a knowledge check) hiding the path
forward @ 01:22:11.
Five “Nega” shadow-doubles of the party manifest and attack @ 01:29:28.
The party finds The Seated Man, cobwebbed and motionless on a throne, holding a staff @ 01:49:06.
Rich fails to steal the staff even with a fate-point reroll; the Seated Man wakes and joins the fight
@ 02:43:22.
Donnie drops to -11 HP from two Nega-Donnie crits, surviving via Resolve and fate points @ 03:04:00.
Session ends mid-fight, unwinnable that night; the party levels to 9 @ 03:11:36.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Andrew, The Seated Man, The Negas, clay golems
Places: The Pyramid / Tests of the Pharaoh, the twin-door corridor, the water-channel staircase hall,
the hidden underwater chamber, the illusory stone wall, the boss chamber
PCs: see the-gang for the Arc I roster

Unresolved
Whether the Seated Man is definitively the source of the visions that drew the party to the temple is
implied but never explicitly confirmed in dialogue @ 01:49:37.

sessions/2020-01-20-the-gang-loots-the-w.title: 2020-01-20 · The Gang Loots the Wizard's Planeshifting Ship
sessions/2020-01-20-the-gang-loots-the-w.content:
Recap
Having killed The Mage who ran the trapped, blood-draining dream-ship, the party loots it: a
Ring of the Hive Mind off a captured intruder, and a planar crystal and Planar Sextant in the
helm room. Experimenting with the sextant, Donnie touches the crystal directly and the party is
plane-shifted, violently materializing out of a travelers’ bag of holding and killing them. Stranded
near the town of Neo, the party refuels the ship’s blood reservoir with the captured intruder, then has
a Neo enchantress permanently bind a captured air elemental to the ship for flight — the elemental later
named “Pop Jack” — making Donnie its bonded “Captain.”
Key events

Jake takes a magical signet ring off an unconscious intruder @ 00:01:12; Nutty IDs it as the
Ring of the Hive Mind on a natural 20 @ 00:03:52–00:04:19.
The party finds the ship’s helm-room crystal (plane shift magic) and a touch-activated
Planar Sextant @ 00:17:25–00:33:43.
Donnie touches the crystal directly; the party is plane-shifted and crushes three travelers emerging
from their bag of holding @ 01:02:51–01:11:29.
The ship’s blood reservoir is found empty; Jake bleeds the captured intruder to refuel it, killing
him @ 01:33:24–01:43:35.
An elderly enchantress in Neo permanently binds a captured air elemental to the ship for 100,000 gold,
granting it flight @ 02:18:13–02:44:38.
The party elects Donnie Captain @ 02:40:23; he speaks the command word “Pop Jack,” permanently
bonding with the elemental @ 02:44:25–02:44:38.
The ship flies to a capital port city to resupply; session ends on a shopping list
@ 03:07:17.

Entities referenced

NPCs: The Mage, the unnamed intruder, the Neo enchantress, Pop Jack
Places: the ship, Kinsess, Neo, the unnamed capital city
Items: Ring of the Hive Mind, Planar Sextant, Ring of Protection +1
PCs: Mori Yoshinari (Donnie), Dread Pirate Bobbert (Rich)

Unresolved
The country’s name is given variously as “Gaethier,” “Manhee,” “Mannhai,” and “Man High” across sessions
— likely the same mishearing, not resolved to one spelling.

sessions/2020-01-28-the-gang-goes-to-the.title: 2020-01-28 · The Gang Goes to the Abyss
sessions/2020-01-28-the-gang-goes-to-the.content:
Recap
In Neo, Mori Yoshinari is nearly exposed as wanted by the Church of St. Cuthbert; the party
intimidates a priest into silence, upgrades gear, and picks up a new bard, Kurt Furbane, who talks
his way onto the crew. Scrying the paladin hunting Mori leads the party to a continent, Soyen-Suenth,
sealed inside a flesh-dissolving green barrier. Unable to breach it, they visit the isolated village of
Mishan, whose population survives on an artifact potato sack Pat (OOC) reveals he planted there — and
decline to take it. That night the ship’s planar crystal activates on its own, yanking the party into the
first layer of the Abyss, cliffhanging as a bone-and-soul demon ship turns toward them.
Key events

Beggars tip off Church of St. Cuthbert agents watching for Mori Yoshinari; the party interrogates
and silences the local priest @ 01:07:45–01:15:30.
Donnie commissions mithril +3 armor and an enchanted katana; Jake has his crystal ball enchanted with
true seeing @ 01:24:28–01:36:27.
Kurt Furbane teleports aboard the ship and charms his way into joining the crew @ 01:58:04–02:10:34.
Scrying finds the paladin hunting Mori studying a map marked over the Isle of Death @ 02:29:42.
The party finds the Soyen-Suenth continent sealed in a barrier that disintegrates flesh on contact
@ 02:42:06–02:47:33.
The village of Mishan survives on an artifact potato sack; Pat (OOC) reveals he planted it there a
year earlier; the party declines to take it @ 03:04:03–03:31:02.
That night the ship’s planar crystal hums and activates unprompted, dragging the ship into the first
layer of the Abyss @ 03:40:30–03:45:48.
Session ends on a cliffhanger as a demon-crewed bone ship turns toward the party @ 04:06:04.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Kurt Furbane, the paladin hunting Mori, the Church of St. Cuthbert priest
Places: Neo, Soyen-Suenth / the Isle of Death, Mishan, the Abyss (first layer)
Items: crystal ball (true seeing), Planar Sextant, the potato sack artifact
Quests: Church of St. Cuthbert manhunt for Mori Yoshinari (dangling); the green death bubble
(dangling)

Unresolved
Place names (Neo, Mogoki/Mugoki, Mishan/Meshun, the paladin’s name) are Whisper transcriptions of
invented fantasy names and may be misspelled.

sessions/2020-03-16-the-gang-gets-an-apo.title: 2020-03-16 · The Gang Gets an Apocalypse Box
sessions/2020-03-16-the-gang-gets-an-apo.content:
Recap
Exploring “Spider Heaven,” the party finds three portal-paintings and dives through the “whimsy wall”
one, triggering d1000 random-effect rolls. Ozan’s near-max roll conjures the Apocalypse Box into his
hands; Jake fails a will save and is magically compelled to seize and guard it, including by force. Ozan
explains its powers before letting Jake keep it. Testing the box nearly summons six Shoggoths twice
before the party burns three fate points to pull a bottle of scotch instead. Donnie reveals the box can
only be destroyed by the bearer surviving three of its monster-waves and then tricking a gold dragon into
crushing it. The party levels to 11 and defers the problem.
Key events

Three portal-paintings found in a demon-lair room: a jail cell, a bar, and a “whimsy wall”
@ 00:05:19.
The party dives through the whimsy wall; d1000 rolls grant Jake +2 Int, a reroll, and a one-time
commune-with-a-deity ability, and Donnie three languages @ 00:13:21–00:16:16.
Ozan’s roll conjures the Apocalypse Box into his hands @ 00:18:15–00:20:36.
Jake fails a DC 30 will save, is compelled to seize the box from Ozan by force, and succeeds
@ 00:22:04–00:27:47.
Ozan identifies the box and explains its powers before ceding it to Jake @ 00:28:35–00:30:11.
Two rerolled box-openings nearly summon six Shoggoths each before a third reroll produces a bottle of
scotch instead @ 00:41:19–00:43:48.
Donnie explains the box can only be destroyed via three survived monster-waves and a gold dragon
crushing it (killing the dragon too) @ 00:48:41–00:49:02.
The party levels to 11; Jake hides the box in his hat @ 00:51:30–00:54:19.

Entities referenced

Items: Apocalypse Box, six Shoggoths (temporary), bottle of scotch
Places: Spider Heaven / Spider Hell, the ship
Quests: Destroy/contain the Apocalypse Box (started, dangling)

Unresolved
The exact mapping of individual d1000 rolls to which player got which Whimsy Wall reward is garbled by
crosstalk and could be swapped.

sessions/2020-03-24-the-gang-witnesses-d.title: 2020-03-24 · The Gang Witnesses Demon Nutty Killing Ozan
sessions/2020-03-24-the-gang-witnesses-d.content:
Recap
With no clean fix for the Apocalypse Box’s curse on Jake (now called Tick-Tick), the party drains
their own blood to refuel the ship and plans to flee to Earth, leaving Tick-Tick behind. While Ozan
manually pumps Tick-Tick’s heart after a near-fatal bleed, an invisible attacker — a demon that has
secretly possessed Nutty’s body since he touched a cursed soul gem sessions earlier — kills Ozan outright,
then kills the unconscious Tick-Tick. With his dying breath Tick-Tick communes with Pelor and is reborn a
Paladin, lifting the box’s curse; he banishes the demon, freeing Nutty. The session ends with Ozan dead
(True Resurrection planned) and the box’s threat resolved.
Key events

The party rules out polymorphing Tick-Tick to dodge the box’s compulsion; it’s tied to his true form
@ 00:34:00.
The party drains its own blood to refuel the ship; Tick-Tick loses 40%+ blood volume and goes into
cardiac arrest @ 00:50:11–00:59:00.
Rich and Donovan find six masked drow digging up a treasure chest in Lolth’s dungeon and talk them into
following the party back to the ship instead of fighting @ 01:43:02–01:47:26.
An invisible attacker kills Ozan’s character outright while he tends to Tick-Tick @ 01:52:40–01:59:28.
The same attacker kills the unconscious Tick-Tick @ 02:19:00–02:22:31.
Dying, Tick-Tick communes with Pelor; his body dissolves and reforms as a Paladin of Pelor, lifting the
box’s curse @ 02:22:10–02:39:50.
The reborn Paladin banishes the demon possessing Nutty with his holy symbol @ 02:42:10.
Nutty wakes disoriented; the soul gem that caused his possession cannot be found afterward @ 02:50:25.
The party agrees to pursue a 25,000gp True Resurrection for Ozan @ 03:17:36.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the demon in Nutty, six masked drow, Pelor, Lolth
PCs: Tick-Tick (dies and is reborn this session), Ozan’s character (dies this session)
Items: Apocalypse Box (curse lifted), the soul gem
Quests: Apocalypse Box curse (resolved), the demon-possessed soul gem (resolved), True Resurrection for
Ozan (started)

Unresolved
Whether the party ever recovers the soul gem is left open — the search of Nutty’s belongings came up
empty.

sessions/2020-03-25-the-gang-gets-outta-.title: 2020-03-25 · The Gang Gets Outta Hell
sessions/2020-03-25-the-gang-gets-outta-.content:
Recap
Still in Hell, the party mass-suggests the drow following them into a trap, restores Nutty’s soul from
its gem, and loots the subdued drow. Rich is teleported alone into a puzzle room and nearly killed by a
soul-sucking demon before Jake and Donnie arrive; the demon is killed and a petrifying basilisk-guardian
statue is freed and dies. Rather than finish the half-solved dungeon, the party flees via the ship’s
interplanar jump — and lands not on the Material Plane but in the Feywild, where a sentient river asks to
speak to Jake. Ozan’s disembodied soul fails to rejoin his destroyed body.
Key events

Rich casts Mass Suggestion on the pursuing drow group, sending them into a trap @ 00:34:50–00:35:39.
Rich recovers the soul gem and restores Nutty’s soul to his body @ 00:42:10–00:44:47.
The party loots the drow (Boots of Blinding Speed, Amulets of Natural Armor, a Cloak of Resistance +3,
a keen longsword) @ 00:48:27–01:06:11.
Rich is teleported alone via a circular key into a puzzle room and found unconscious, being drained by
a soul-sucking demon @ 00:57:32–01:15:43.
The demon fails a save and is suggested into an 11-hour “timeout”; while it’s stuck there, Rich frees
himself and a basilisk-guardian statue pair from its own gaze via Wall of Force, killing the
petrified guardian and dropping a necklace of keys @ 01:31:56–01:34:24. The party then returns and
finishes the demon off (it hides in a shadow-jump first) for good @ 01:54:44–01:54:55.
The party abandons the rest of the dungeon and has Donnie pilot an interplanar jump
@ 02:28:47–02:33:21.
The ship lands in the Feywild/First World instead of home; a sentient river asks to speak to Jake
@ 02:40:38–02:43:16.
Ozan’s disembodied soul fails to rejoin his destroyed body @ 02:49:42.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the soul-sucking demon, the armored-man/basilisk guardian, the drow group
Places: Hell/the Abyss, the secret puzzle room, the Feywild/First World
Items: soul gem (resolved), Boots of Blinding Speed, necklace of keys
Quests: Escape Hell (completed this session); recover/resurrect Ozan (ongoing)

Unresolved
“Atza,” named once in the recap as owner of a different soul-trapped gem and body, is never reconciled
with the rest of the session’s soul-gem plotline.

sessions/2020-04-06-the-gang-finds-a-fro.title: 2020-04-06 · The Gang Finds a Frozen Elephant Man
sessions/2020-04-06-the-gang-finds-a-fro.content:
Recap
In an escalating monster-trial on an “upside-down” pocket plane, the party fights two demonic creatures
while Nutty finds a frozen Loxodon, Obadiah Jones, sealed in ice beside his dead former party. After
every indignity short of fire fails to melt the ice, Rich’s summoned fire elementals free Obadiah, who
wakes disoriented and covered in urine. Mid-fight, one demon grapples Jake, drags him into the Ethereal
Plane, and drains his Strength to 0, knocking him unconscious there — the session ends with the party
unable to reach him.
Key events

Donnie is turned to stone by a basilisk at the session’s start and remains petrified throughout
@ 00:24:06.
Two black-fleshed demons spawn the moment the basilisks die @ 00:25:17.
Nutty finds a side room with Obadiah Jones frozen in ice beside his dead former party’s skeletons
@ 00:49:11–01:57:36.
Multiple attempts to melt the ice fail (prestidigitation, feathers, urine) until Rich summons three
fire elementals @ 01:07:57–01:37:47.
Obadiah wakes, freed, confused, and covered in pee and fire elementals @ 01:45:29.
One demon grapples Jake, drags him into the Ethereal Plane, and drains his Strength to 0 over several
rounds, knocking him unconscious there @ 01:31:42–01:59:08.
The surviving demon resists repeated suggestion/mass suggestion attempts to bring Jake back
@ 02:08:31–02:10:00.
Session ends with the party still trying to figure out how to reach the Ethereal Plane
@ 02:13:51.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Obadiah Jones (joins the party), the two demons
Places: the trial dungeon / pocket plane, the ice room
Quests: Rescue Jake from the Ethereal Plane (started, unresolved this session)

Unresolved
The mechanism by which the party eventually reaches Jake in the Ethereal Plane is not shown — he is back
and active by the next session.

sessions/2020-04-13-the-gang-fights-a-ch.title: 2020-04-13 · The Gang Fights a Church Demon
sessions/2020-04-13-the-gang-fights-a-ch.content:
Recap
Caring for a newborn god-baby pulled from a shrine pearl, the party flies the (now permanently airborne)
ship to a temple hosting a paladin’s knighting ceremony. Tick-Tick’s joke about “nosebleed” seating gets
him challenged to a duel. Mid-ceremony the paladin transforms into a glabrezu demon, kills the high
priest, and casts Confusion and Reverse Gravity on the crowd. The party kills the demon in a running
fight; when the spells end, the airborne, confused crowd crashes back down, killing nearly everyone else
in the temple. A voice announces Clydewell Keep has fallen as Pat ends the session; the party hits level
12.
Key events

A blank metal pendant clasps itself around the shrine-baby’s neck unprompted; detect magic shows it
radiating overwhelming divine power @ 00:41:00–00:53:34.
The party decides to raise the baby themselves as the founder of their own religion
@ 00:49:08–00:53:49.
The party talks its way into Sir Holton Albright’s knighting ceremony claiming to represent a
church of Pelor @ 01:36:34–01:41:15.
Tick-Tick is forcibly thrown out over a “nosebleeds” joke and challenged to a duel to the death the next
sunrise @ 01:43:28–01:46:49.
Mid-anointing, Sir Holton transforms into a glabrezu demon, instantly kills the high priest, and casts
Confusion and Reverse Gravity on the crowd @ 01:52:04–02:35:32.
The party kills the demon in a running fight across the ceiling and floor; Kurt Furbank lands the
finishing blow @ 03:08:50–03:35:20.
Confusion and Reverse Gravity end simultaneously; the airborne crowd crashes down, killing nearly
everyone left in the temple @ 03:35:41.
A voice announces Clydewell Keep has fallen; the session ends and the party reaches level 12
@ 03:36:47–03:40:42.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Sir Holton Albright, the high priest, the offended knight
Places: the flooded shrine, Clydewell Keep, the temple
Items: the god-baby’s pendant
Quests: raising the god-baby (started); Jake’s duel to the death (started, interrupted); Clydewell
Keep’s fall (new hook, unresolved); the miasma crisis (ongoing, no progress this session)

Unresolved
Whether “Kurt Furbank,” here played by Nutty, is the same character as Kurt Furbane, Ozan’s bard
introduced in an earlier session, is not reconciled — see that page’s Unresolved section.

sessions/2020-09-28-ozandm-the-gang-does.title: 2020-09-28 · The Gang Does a Kidnap Job
sessions/2020-09-28-ozandm-the-gang-does.content:
Recap
A one-shot interlude DM’d by Ozan (Pat plays a PC this time). Disguised with Pat’s elixirs, the party
infiltrates a mansion banquet to kidnap a goblin, Littlepen, who’s attending as a guest of the
Aspis Corporation. A guard sweep for an unregistered goblin nearly blows the operation; Pat distracts
with a self-inflicted wound and an Alchemist’s Fire, poisoned soup sickens half the banquet, and under
cover of darkness the party beats Littlepen unconscious and flees through a jungle gauntlet, outrunning
pursuing guards. The job succeeds, though no one remembers the payment.
Key events

Guards sweep for an unregistered goblin, rounding up Littlepen and the disguised Donnie
@ 00:17:30.
Pat deliberately wounds himself and ignites Alchemist’s Fire to cause chaos and cover an escape attempt
@ 00:29:52–00:57:00.
The party’s poisoned soup sickens roughly half the banquet, including Littlepen
@ 01:26:38–01:27:17.
Rich’s Darkness spell blacks out the stage; Nutty and Donnie move in on the hallucinating Littlepen
@ 01:31:05–02:12:04.
Jake knocks Littlepen fully unconscious and carries him out @ 02:19:45–02:20:27.
The party flees through a jungle obstacle course chased by guards; a critical Sleep spell frees Jake
from a last grapple @ 02:47:52–03:11:14.
The party boards its getaway boat with Littlepen secured and reaches level 5 @ 03:19:14–03:22:03.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Littlepen, the Aspis Corporation guard, the mansion’s guard captain
Factions: Aspis Corporation
Places: the mansion/banquet hall, the jungle, the river getaway
Quests: Kidnap Littlepen (completed); payment for the job (dangling, no one remembers the sum)

Unresolved
Whether this one-shot connects to the main Arc I or Arc II storyline is never addressed; see
the-gang.

sessions/2021-10-19-the-gang-answers-thr.title: 2021-10-19 · The Gang Answers Three Riddles
sessions/2021-10-19-the-gang-answers-thr.content:
Recap
Deep in a cult’s abandoned underground complex, the party finds evidence of a heart-stealing ritual tied
to an incoming “new lord,” Brother Felhorn. A living Sphinx Painting demands three riddles be
answered to pass, zapping failed guesses with lightning before the party gets all three right. Beyond it,
a Nexus-portal device lets Alexander scout a frozen plane with ice golems and a frost giant. After
resting, having their aging curses lifted, and gearing up, the party (minus Donnie and Ozan, who stay
behind with the now-sentient Sphinx) steps through the one-way portal — arriving face-to-face with the
frost giant on a cliffhanger.
Key events

The party finds cultist quarters, desiccated heart-removed bodies, and a note naming a ritual gathering
to welcome “Brother Felhorn” @ 00:07:22–00:18:33.
A living Sphinx Painting demands three riddles to pass a secret door, lightning-zapping wrong
guesses @ 00:27:24–00:58:56.
All three riddles are answered correctly (the letter N; sawdust; time), with heavy damage taken along
the way @ 00:41:50–00:58:02.
The floor teleports the party into a new sealed complex with a Nexus-portal device
@ 00:58:56–01:08:00.
Alexander scouts the portal’s destination remotely via his Psycrystal: a frozen plane with ice
golems, a frost giant, and treasure @ 01:08:00–01:17:35.
The party rests in town, has aging curses lifted for free by a church of Abadar, and gears up for cold
weather @ 02:34:30–02:55:44.
The party (minus Donnie and Ozan, who remain with the Sphinx) steps through the one-way portal and
arrives on the frozen plane facing the frost giant and ice golems @ 03:08:00.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Sphinx Painting, Brother Felhorn (unseen), the church priest/janitor
Factions: Grimson Knights
Items: the ship’s… — see Locate Portal Sextant, Psycrystal, Ember (sword)
Quests: discover what’s through the Nexus portal network (progressed); complete the seven-jewel
locate-portal sextant (started)

Unresolved
Whether the painting is “the Sphinx” or “the Phoenix” is used inconsistently in the transcript; treated
here as one entity, the Sphinx.

sessions/2021-11-02-the-gang-teleports-a.title: 2021-11-02 · The Gang Teleports Away a Frost Giant
sessions/2021-11-02-the-gang-teleports-a.content:
Recap
Mid-teleport onto a blizzard-swept mountaintop, the party (Donnie absent, his character Fish piloted
by Rich) faces a frost giant and four golem escorts with a sheer cliff at their backs. Alexander’s
dislocator gun repeatedly teleports the golems away one at a time while the rest of the party burns them
down; the giant flees on foot. A knowledge check reveals the party is in the Nexus, a planar prison they
cannot plane-shift out of — the only way forward is through a chain of gem-keyed portals. After looting
three treasure chests (including a mimic disguised as a sword), the party rests, newly self-declared
“champions of the North,” with a new gem suggesting a fiery plane next.
Key events

The party arrives mid-teleport on a mountaintop facing a frost giant and four golems, with a sheer
120-ft cliff behind them @ 00:00:29–00:16:06.
A knowledge check reveals the plane is “the Nexus,” a prison for powerful evil beings akin to Carceri
but under separate management @ 00:18:18–00:19:54.
Alexander’s dislocator gun “Becky” teleports golems dozens of miles away one at a time, removing
them from the fight @ 00:20:53–01:16:00.
The main giant flees on foot after being hit with Jake’s dislocator and the party’s damage
@ 01:19:19.
The party loots three treasure chests (~50,000 gold in gems) and several joke/magic items; one “sword”
turns out to be a mimic, eventually killed after being greased, laughter-stunned, and lassoed off a
cliff @ 01:20:01–01:59:23.
The party confirms the sextant can’t get them back out — they must advance through a chain of linked
portals @ 02:30:02.
Session ends with the party resting before pushing toward a suspected fiery plane next
@ 02:36:29.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the frost giant, the mimic
Places: The Nexus, the frigid mountaintop battlefield
Items: Locate Portal Sextant, Becky (dislocator gun), assorted Nexus loot (hat of Steve, dagger of
the poet, inverse umbrella)
Quests: escape the Nexus (started, open at session’s end — the last recorded session)

Unresolved
The main antagonist is called a “frost giant” throughout the fight but a “storm giant” once by Pat
afterward — unclear if this is a slip or a deliberate detail.

sessions/2022-12-06-the-gang-goes-to-rav.title: 2022-12-06 · The Gang Goes to Ravenloft (1)
sessions/2022-12-06-the-gang-goes-to-rav.content:
Recap
The party gathered at a goblin-run roadside inn, where two robed strangers checked in and left everyone
unsettled @ 00:25:34–00:33:28. That night the whole party shared a prophetic nightmare of a vampire, a
crying letter-writer, and a storm-wreathed castle @ 00:54:14. The next morning a letter arrived, signed by
Kolyan Indirovich, Burgomaster of Barovia, pleading for help for his bitten daughter — alongside an
unrelated dinner invitation from “the Baron” that led to the same place @ 01:07:29–01:28:52.
Forcing a goblin to guide them through the enchanted mists, the party found a dead villager carrying a
forged copy of the plea letter, his wounds marked as a transformed human’s, not an animal’s
@ 01:58:10–02:02:16. In the fog-bound village of Barovia they met its sole remaining priest, who revealed
the Baron was the vampire terrorizing the land and gave them a map to Castle Ravenloft
@ 02:09:38–02:18:39. At the Blood of the Vine tavern they met Ismark Indirovich, confirmed neither
letter was his father’s real handwriting, and found his sister Irina twice-bitten by
Strahd and refusing to be restrained; the family ordered the party off their property
@ 02:32:48–03:07:21.
Sheltering overnight in the village church, the party watched harmless ghosts march toward the castle at
midnight @ 03:24:44. The next day Madame Eva gave them a tarot reading — Death, a reversed card of
conflict, and the Fool — plus a prophecy of “a tool of evil” protected by darkness @ 03:44:15–03:52:28.
Choosing to approach by daylight rather than attend the night’s dinner, the party rode a mysterious black
carriage to Castle Ravenloft, whose doors swung open on their own as organ music drifted out
@ 04:10:50–04:36:16.
Key events

A shared prophetic nightmare hits the whole party: a vampire, a crying letter-writer, a storm-wreathed
castle @ 00:54:14.
A page delivers Kolyan Indirovich’s plea for help, and the party realizes it shares directions with
an unrelated dinner invitation from “the Baron” @ 01:06:39–01:28:52.
Jake’s character forces a young goblin to guide the party through the magical mists around Barovia
@ 01:17:14.
The party finds a dead villager holding a forged copy of the plea letter, killed by what Donnie’s
character identifies (natural 20) as a transformed human, not an animal @ 01:58:10–01:59:09.
The village priest reveals the Baron is the vampire Strahd and gives the party a map to the castle
@ 02:15:24–02:18:39.
The party meets Ismark Indirovich and finds Irina bitten twice by Strahd, with
no reflection; she and Ismark refuse restraint and order the party out @ 02:52:37–03:07:21.
Ghosts rise from the churchyard at midnight and walk harmlessly toward the castle @ 03:24:44.
Madame Eva gives the party a tarot reading and a prophecy about “a tool of evil” @ 03:44:15–03:52:28.
A driverless black carriage carries the party to Castle Ravenloft, whose doors open on their own as
the session ends @ 04:12:35–04:34:13.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich, Kolyan Indirovich, Ismark Indirovich, Irina Indirovich, the
unnamed village priest, Madame Eva
Places: the roadside goblin inn, Svalich Woods, Village of Barovia, the Indirovich estate, the
village church, the gypsy encampment, Castle Ravenloft
Items: Ion Stone, Aegis of Recovery, Scabbard of Keen Edges, the Shadow Well, the forged plea letter,
the map to Castle Ravenloft
Quests: Rescue the Burgomaster’s Family (started), Find the Tool of Evil (started)

sessions/2022-12-18-the-gang-meets-strah.title: 2022-12-18 · The Gang Meets Strahd For Dinner (Ravenloft 2)
sessions/2022-12-18-the-gang-meets-strah.content:
Recap
The party entered Castle Ravenloft’s foyer to distant organ music, startled a servant hidden inside a
suit of armor, and followed the sound to a grand dining hall where a caped figure introduced himself as
their host, Strahd von Zarovich @ 00:19:27–00:42:14. Jacques threw his dinner roll
at him; Strahd vanished with a maniacal laugh, and every door slammed shut, every torch went out, and all
the food disappeared as the castle’s lights cut out @ 00:43:04–00:45:43.
Searching behind a secret door, Alumbra found a mannequin double of Strahd rigged on ropes and
mirrors — a decoy, which Todd set on fire @ 00:51:24–00:53:45. Heading down into a rotting cell corridor,
the party was ambushed by skeletons, wiped out mostly by Xarthax’s fireball, and found a colony of
“truth slugs” @ 01:08:11–01:43:49. Donnie’s character rejoined partway through. Deeper in, they
knocked out a deranged lantern-carrying servant obsessed with “the tower,” cured Donnie’s familiar of a
cauldron-induced brain-craving, and found Strahd’s own journal — the cursed
Tome of Strahd — hidden under his mattress @ 01:54:57–02:14:51. A trap door dropped Todd and the
familiar fifty feet into a flooded dungeon level, where the rest of the party followed; the session ended
with everyone chest-deep in black water, stuck on a locked gate guarding a gold chest @ 02:22:33–02:43:09.
Key events

Todd bumps a suit of armor with someone breathing inside it, silencing the organ music @ 00:31:45.
The party meets Strahd von Zarovich at dinner; Jacques throws a roll at him and he vanishes, locking
down the castle @ 00:42:14–00:45:43.
Alumbra finds a secret door behind the organ hiding a rope-and-mirror Strahd decoy, burned by Todd
@ 00:51:24–00:53:45.
Xarthax’s fireball wipes most of a skeleton ambush in a rotting cell corridor @ 01:19:21–01:22:17.
The party finds and takes magical “truth slugs” from the cells @ 01:34:47–01:43:49.
Jacques knocks out a deranged lantern servant and loots his lantern and keys
@ 01:56:11–02:07:17.
Donnie’s zoog familiar drinks from a cauldron of disembodied zombie heads and develops a brain-craving,
cured by Remove Curse @ 02:04:20–02:08:49.
The party finds the cursed Tome of Strahd hidden under the mattress in Strahd’s personal chamber
@ 02:09:47–02:14:51.
A trap door drops Todd and the familiar fifty feet into a flooded dungeon level; the rest of the party
follows @ 02:19:49–02:35:49.
Session ends with the party stuck on a locked gate guarding a gold-filled chest @ 02:31:28–02:43:09.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich (and his decoy mannequin), the lantern servant, the zombie heads
Places: Castle Ravenloft — the dining hall, the secret puppet room, the rotting cell corridor, the
cauldron room, Strahd’s personal chamber, the flooded lower dungeon
Items: Tome of Strahd, truth slugs, the lantern servant’s keyring, the treasure chest (unopened)
Quests: Defeat Strahd (started), Escape the Mists (started)

sessions/2022-12-26-the-gang-sets-fire-t.title: 2022-12-26 · The Gang Sets Fire to a Gas Trap (Ravenloft 3)
sessions/2022-12-26-the-gang-sets-fire-t.content:
Recap
Picking up in the flooded basement of Castle Ravenloft, Todd and
Ozan’s character found themselves trapped in a cell at the bottom of a hundred-foot
shaft, across from cells stuffed with gold and silver @ 00:34:37–00:38:55. While looting it, a hidden
mechanism flooded a nearby cell with poison gas; Nutty threw a lit torch in to test if it was flammable —
it was, and the room burned continuously for the rest of the session @ 01:15:42–01:20:21.
Jake’s character escaped into the Ethereal Plane, Xarthax flew in to rescue people,
and Jess’s character had to be freed from a burning cell with an Air Bubble spell while
Ozan picked the lock @ 01:37:00–03:51:03.
Exploring upward, the party met Bartholomew, a sentient, multi-personality suit of armor obsessed with
killing pets, and signed a mysterious guestbook nearby @ 02:09:05–02:22:54. Scouting ethereally, Jake
glimpsed a two-throne room and a torture chamber, and the party heard what sounded like a marching army
somewhere above, never confirmed as real @ 01:55:16–02:04:41. Pushing through more trapped corridors, they
freed a prisoner, Murph, who immediately re-triggered a teleport trap @ 03:04:37–03:07:18.
Jake eventually fought through the active fire to claim a magic sword that shapeshifts
into whatever weapon its wielder imagines @ 03:58:19–03:59:58. The session ended with [[Raven|Donnie’s
character]] pickpocketing a chained bookkeeper for 333 gold @ 04:20:08–04:22:51.
Key events

Todd and Ozan’s character are trapped at the bottom of a hundred-foot funnel shaft, across from
gold-filled cells @ 00:34:37–00:38:55.
The party recovers 630 gold and nearly 5,000 silver, triggering an electrified gate @ 01:11:45–01:13:20.
A hidden mechanism floods a cell with poison gas; Nutty ignites it with a torch, starting a
fire that burns the rest of the session @ 01:15:42–01:20:21.
Jake goes Ethereal to escape the heat; Xarthax flies in to rescue people from the burning cells
@ 01:19:14–01:48:02.
The party meets Bartholomew, a sentient suit of armor that hunts pets but can be reasoned with
@ 02:09:05–02:20:52.
Jake, scouting ethereally, glimpses a throne room and a torture chamber with ghostly victims
@ 01:55:16–02:27:08.
The party hears a marching, howling army somewhere above — never confirmed as real @ 01:56:54–01:58:42.
Murph is freed from a cell and immediately steps on a teleport trap @ 03:04:37–03:07:18.
Donnie casts Air Bubble to buy time while Ozan picks the lock on Jess’s burning cell @ 03:47:18–03:53:00.
Jake braves the fire trap and claims a shapeshifting magic sword, later identified as the
Sun Sword’s blade @ 03:58:24–03:59:58.
Donnie’s Raven pickpockets a chained bookkeeper for a pouch of 333 gold @ 04:22:30–04:22:51.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Bartholomew, Murph, the chained bookkeeper, the Count (referenced, not encountered)
Places: Castle Ravenloft — the flooded basement prison, the servant’s entrance room, the throne
room, the torture chamber, the upper-floor bookkeeper’s room
Items: the Sun Sword (as an unidentified shapeshifting sword), gold and silver loot, a scroll and
333 gold stolen from the bookkeeper
Quests: Find the Tool of Evil (the basement’s rumored magic item, resolved this session)

sessions/2023-01-30-ravenloft-3-piss-coa.title: 2023-01-30 · Ravenloft 3: Piss Coat Bugaloo
sessions/2023-01-30-ravenloft-3-piss-coa.content:
Recap
The party found a chained goblin scribe tending an endless ledger for “the hag,” knocked him out after
spotting a “magical scepter” on his table, and looted 415 gold @ 00:13:11–00:22:31. Ghostly arms then
ambushed them through a throne-room window; their wailing scream knocked most of the party unconscious and
carried them to a prison cell atop the castle’s highest spire, where a well-dressed man — almost certainly
Strahd von Zarovich — appeared below, waved, and turned to mist @ 00:33:53–01:33:50.
Blocked by a magical force field, Jake and Nutty invented “piss coat” —
soaking a hide in urine to lever warded bars apart — which worked repeatedly for the rest of the session
@ 01:15:52–04:25:30. Below, the party found ancient catacombs lined with Strahd’s family crypts: they
killed a banshee revealed as Sasha Ivliskova, one of Strahd’s wives, looting 3,300 gold
@ 02:19:40–03:07:19; Nutty accidentally woke a vampire bride, Petrina Velikovna, by pouring his own
blood into her mouth, and the party beheaded her @ 03:15:51–03:21:00. In a third crypt they found
Sergei’s preserved body with the Sun Sword’s blade and magic armor; holy water
triggered a mind-link revealing Strahd murdered his own brother and Tatiana out of jealousy
@ 03:50:41–04:10:16.
Reaching Strahd’s own crypt, the party piss-coated through warded bars that had briefly turned Jess’s
character to stone. Donnie, chasing a lost familiar, crashed into the final bars, touched
Strahd’s sealed coffin area, and was fatally drained — dying and rising on the spot as a chaotic-evil
vampire thrall @ 04:56:54–05:19:31. The whole party leveled up to 6th level; the session ended with Strahd
still asleep in his coffin, the Sun Sword’s hilt still missing, and the party down one ally turned vampire.
Key events

The party knocks out a chained goblin accountant and loots 415 gold @ 00:13:11–00:22:31.
Four ghosts ambush the party through a window; their scream knocks most of the party out and carries
them to the top of the castle’s spire @ 00:33:53–01:10:34.
A well-dressed man, likely Strahd, appears below the spire, waves, and turns to mist @ 01:33:50.
Jake and Nutty invent “piss coat” to bend warded bars and bypass a magical force field
@ 04:25:30 (first notable use among several).
The party discovers catacombs beneath the keep, roosted by bats, holding ~30 family crypts
@ 02:05:07.
The party kills a banshee revealed as Sasha Ivliskova, one of Strahd’s wives, looting 3,300 gold
@ 02:19:40–03:07:19.
Nutty accidentally awakens the vampire bride Petrina Velikovna by pouring blood into her mouth; she
is knocked out and beheaded @ 03:15:51–03:21:00.
The party finds Sergei von Zarovich’s preserved body with the Sun Sword’s blade and magic armor
@ 03:50:41.
Holy water on Sergei’s body creates a mind-link revealing Strahd murdered Sergei and Tatiana out of
jealousy @ 04:00:19–04:10:16.
A Spellcraft check identifies Jake’s sword as the legendary Sun Sword — its hilt long separated and
still lost @ 04:10:16.
Jess’s character turns to stone touching warded bars at Strahd’s crypt, later restored
@ 04:13:44–04:20:48.
Donnie’s character is fatally drained near Strahd’s sealed coffin, dies, and rises as a
chaotic-evil vampire thrall @ 04:56:54–05:19:31.
The whole party levels up to 6th level @ 05:20:21.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich, Sasha Ivliskova, Petrina Velikovna, Sergei von Zarovich,
Tatiana, the goblin accountant, the four ghosts
Places: the accountant’s office, the throne/window room, the spire, the warded stairwell, the
catacombs, Strahd’s crypt — all within Castle Ravenloft
Items: the Sun Sword (identified this session), Sergei’s magic armor, the Vonderbux signet ring, the
fanged skull trophy
Quests: Find the Sun Sword’s Hilt (started), Rescue Donovan (started, via Raven’s
vampirization)

sessions/2023-02-12-ravenloft-4-mistform.title: 2023-02-12 · Ravenloft 4: Mistform, Babaaay
sessions/2023-02-12-ravenloft-4-mistform.content:
Recap
The party picked up moments after Donovan had risen as a vampire thrall with glowing red eyes;
he won initiative and fled as mist through a crack near the ceiling before anyone could stop him
@ 00:00:00–00:10:31. Forcing open the bent bars of the gate he’d left behind, the rest of the party reached
a coffin room; Woo failed a save prying the central sarcophagus and briefly turned to
stone before Xarthax restored him with Dispel Magic @ 00:16:35–00:36:18. The coffin itself was empty
but for a child’s teddy bear and blanket @ 00:42:03–00:43:36.
With no other way forward, the party joined hands and teleported through a magical alcove, arriving
directly in front of Strahd himself in an ornate chamber guarded by clay statues
@ 00:56:47–01:04:51. Strahd immediately dominated most of the party; only Woo and
Xarthax resisted. Under his control, Todd was forced to attack Woo, and — most brutally —
Jess’s character sneak-attacked Jake’s character for 21 damage, dropping him
to the brink of death; the party burned their last two fate points to force a missed reroll and save him
@ 01:00:30–01:30:24. The fight dragged on through Strahd’s invisibility, spider-climbing, a second
fireball, and mist form, while the party kept Jake alive with potions and finally let him land two flaming
Hurricane Kicks that hurt Strahd even in mist form @ 01:33:00–02:23:10. Strahd escaped into the ceiling
cracks as mist; the session ended with the party bruised, out of fate points, and alive deep inside the
castle @ 02:23:45–02:25:17.
Key events

Donovan, now a vampire thrall, wins initiative and flees as mist through a gap in the
mortar @ 00:03:28–00:10:31.
The party squeezes through bent gate bars into a coffin room warded with necromancy @ 00:16:35–00:23:13.
Woo fails a save prying the coffin and turns to stone; Xarthax’s Dispel Magic restores him
@ 00:30:57–00:36:18.
The coffin is pried fully open and found empty except for a teddy bear and blanket @ 00:42:03–00:43:16.
The party joins hands and teleports through a magical alcove directly in front of
Strahd @ 00:56:47–00:58:14.
Strahd’s domination gaze takes effect on most of the party; only Woo and Xarthax resist @ 01:00:30.
Under domination, Todd attacks Woo and Jess sneak-attacks Jake for 21 damage, dropping him to -17 HP;
the party burns two fate points to force a miss and save him @ 01:17:00–01:30:46.
Strahd cycles through invisibility, spider climb, a second fireball, and mist form while the party
revives Jake with potions and Fly @ 01:38:05–02:10:47.
Jake lands two flaming Hurricane Kicks on Strahd, including one that damages his mist form
@ 02:10:47–02:22:21.
Strahd escapes through cracks in the ceiling as mist, ending the fight @ 02:23:45.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich, Donovan (fled, not directly fought)
Places: Castle Ravenloft — the barred coffin room, Strahd’s audience chamber, a hidden room with
thrones and wraiths
Items: a golden chest (unlooted), the coffin’s teddy bear and blanket
Quests: Rescue Donovan (progressed — Donovan is now loose in the castle as a thrall),
Defeat Strahd (ongoing)

sessions/2023-03-12-ravenloft-golem-trap.title: 2023-03-12 · Ravenloft Golem Trap
sessions/2023-03-12-ravenloft-golem-trap.content:
Recap
Picking up after Strahd misted into the walls of his casket room, the party found a new 30-foot
gargoyle-carved chamber with two four-armed iron statues, a suspended hourglass, and a golden chest marked
“lots and lots of loot” @ 00:19:11–00:22:58. Ozan spotted a riddle on the hourglass and
disarmed a trap on the chest, but the party dithered over the statues’ colored gems while the hourglass
sand began falling and all four doors locked @ 00:24:30–00:36:09. Rich blew open the one
unlocked-looking door with a scroll of Knock just as the sand ran out and two iron golems animated
@ 00:42:26–00:44:19.
The fight turned rough: both golems breathed poison gas, afflicting Wu and
Alumbra with Constitution damage. Alumbra nearly died fleeing up a dead-end stairwell after a critical
fumble left her prone between both golems, saved by a burned Fate Point and a Shadow Clone escape
@ 00:50:23–01:35:24. The tide turned when the first golem critically fumbled and tripped itself, letting
the party focus it down for nearly 100 damage; the second similarly stumbled and was finished off with
Magic Missile @ 01:57:23–02:29:01. With both golems dead, every door unlocked and four colored gems fell
from their hands. The party rested overnight, and Ozan brewed an antidote that cured
the lingering poison by morning; the session ended with the party close to 7th level and the golden
chest’s true contents never recovered @ 02:29:52–02:39:37.
Key events

The party finds a gargoyle-carved puzzle room: iron statues holding colored gems, a riddle-inscribed
hourglass, and a trapped golden chest @ 00:22:58–00:36:09.
Ozan disarms a trap on the chest, revealing illusion magic underneath; the chest proves empty
@ 00:33:35–00:41:38.
The hourglass’s sand runs out, animating two iron golems, just as Rich blasts open a locked door with a
scroll of Knock (43 vs. DC 40) @ 00:42:26–00:44:19.
Both golems breathe poison gas repeatedly, inflicting Constitution damage on Wu and Alumbra
@ 00:50:23–02:12:36.
Alumbra rolls a natural 1 fleeing between the golems, nearly dies, and is saved by a Fate Point and a
Shadow Clone escape @ 01:11:50–01:35:24.
The first golem critically fumbles and trips prone; the party focuses it down for ~98 damage
@ 01:57:23–02:04:00.
The second golem critically fumbles, twisting its ankle; Rich finishes it with Magic Missile
@ 02:21:15–02:29:01.
Four colored gems fall from the golems’ hands, collected by Rich for research @ 02:30:10.
Ozan brews an antidote overnight, curing Wu and Alumbra’s poison by morning @ 02:35:17–02:38:36.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich (mentioned, misted away before the session begins), two unnamed Iron
Golems
Places: the gargoyle/brazier puzzle room and the dead-end stairwell, both within Castle Ravenloft
Items: the golden chest (empty but for an unexplained noise), four colored gem stones, a scroll of
Knock, a Barkskin potion
Quests: none new — continuation of exploring Castle Ravenloft

sessions/2023-03-18-ravenloft-the-bitch-.title: 2023-03-18 · Ravenloft — The Bitch of the Mist Goes to the Astral Plane
sessions/2023-03-18-ravenloft-the-bitch-.content:
Recap
Recapping a victory over Donovan that turned out to be another trap (an hourglass device and a
golem hallway), the party found a secret door to a new level and a bedroom shrouded in magical darkness
@ 00:14:06–00:27:50. Jake was mauled by a horse-headed demon lurking in the dark; once
Rich dispelled it, the party also found Donovan hiding in the corner — revealed to
have secretly been serving the castle’s vampire lord all along, waiting to ambush whoever entered
@ 00:48:16 onward. In the fight that followed, Donovan dominated Jake, summoned a delayed pack of wolves,
and traded blows with the party while the demon clawed everyone in the dark; the party dropped him to 0
HP, at which point he turned to vampire mist, and Jess finished the demon with a critical sneak attack.
Trying to contain Donovan’s mist form, the party stuffed him into Jess’s handy haversack.
Todd, trying to help free him, instead destroyed the haversack with his shield, tearing open
a gate that flung Donovan into the Astral Plane with only two hours to find a resting place or be
destroyed forever. The delayed wolves then arrived and were fought off, leaving several party members
badly hurt; Jess was also infected with Contagion by the demon. After looting the bedroom and nearby
alcoves, the party opened a servants’ dining hall and was ambushed by the ghosts of roughly 400 castle
inhabitants, who nearly wiped the party with aging and fear attacks before withdrawing — Rich’s android,
immune to mind effects, fear, and aging, tanked the fight almost single-handedly. Resting afterward, the
party heard midnight bells and screaming, found a previously-rescued prisoner dead with his eyes removed,
and the session ended with Todd pressing on alone toward a tower with a pulsing red glass “heart.”
Key events

Recap: the party had already defeated Donovan off-mic before the session’s live portion began
@ 00:14:06.
The party finds a secret door and a bedroom shrouded in magical darkness @ 00:27:50–00:48:16.
A horse-headed demon maul Jake in the dark; once dispelled, Donovan is found hiding in the corner,
revealed as a traitor secretly serving the castle’s vampire lord @ 00:48:16 onward.
Donovan dominates Jake, summons delayed wolves, and fights the party alongside the demon; he is dropped
to 0 HP and turns to vampire mist, while Jess kills the demon with a sneak attack.
The party stuffs Donovan’s mist form into Jess’s handy haversack; Todd destroys the haversack trying to
free him, flinging Donovan into the Astral Plane with a two-hour limit before permanent destruction.
The delayed wolf summons arrive and are fought off, leaving the party badly hurt; Jess is infected with
Contagion by the demon.
The party loots the bedroom (wand of ray of frost, scroll of remove curse, a falchion) and pulls a hot
gem from the demon’s corpse, which Jake swallows and then vomits back up.
The party opens a servants’ dining hall and is ambushed by the ghosts of ~400 castle inhabitants, nearly
wiped by aging/fear attacks; Rich’s android (immune to mind effects, fear, and aging) tanks the fight.
Resting afterward, the party hears midnight bells and screaming, and finds a previously-rescued prisoner
dead with his eyes removed.
The session ends with Todd pressing on alone toward a tower with a pulsing red glass “heart.”

Entities referenced

NPCs: Donovan (revealed as a traitor, lost to the Astral Plane), Strahd von Zarovich (as
the unnamed “boss guy” Donovan secretly served), a horse-headed demon, the ~400 ghosts of the servants’
dining hall, an unnamed rescued prisoner (found dead)
Places: the dark bedroom, several loot alcoves, the servants’ dining hall, the Astral Plane, the tower
with the pulsing red glass heart — all within or beyond Castle Ravenloft
Items: wand of ray of frost, scroll of remove curse, a falchion, a hot gem (swallowed and vomited by
Jake), the handy haversack (destroyed)
Quests: Rescue Donovan (failed/derailed — he is lost to the Astral Plane),
Find the Sun Sword’s Hilt (mentioned, still open)

sessions/2023-03-18-ravenloft-the-bitch-.title: 2023-03-18 · Ravenloft: The Bitch of the Mist, Part 2
sessions/2023-03-18-ravenloft-the-bitch-.content:
Recap
Continuing directly from the session’s first half, Todd pressed on alone through
Castle Ravenloft’s upper dungeon while the rest of the party rested below at dangerously low HP,
unable to safely move or fight @ 00:02:46–00:04:06. He avoided a spiderweb-choked room and fixated on a
pulsating red light deeper in as his next objective @ 00:02:51–00:03:14. The party glimpsed part of a
stairwell on the map before broken dynamic lighting brought exploration to a halt; with six hours already
played, Pat called the session there @ 00:18:11–00:22:21.
In recap, the table agreed their last two encounters had nearly been party wipes: the ghost/ghoul ambush
while resting should have killed everyone and was stopped only because Rich’s android turned
out immune, with no mechanic for Pat to finish him off @ 00:22:33–00:57:14. They also recalled
Donovan’s betrayal and a separate, earlier capture by a less lethal group of ghosts who caged and
aged the party and stole their copy of the Tome of Strahd @ 00:23:43–00:35:05. Everyone leveled up to
7th level, and the back half of the session was spent on character-build bookkeeping — Jake weighing feats,
Rich weighing new 4th-level wizard spells.
Key events

Todd continues alone up the stairs while the rest of the party rests at low HP, unable to move safely
@ 00:02:46–00:04:06.
Todd avoids a spiderweb-filled room and fixates on a pulsating red light as his next objective
@ 00:02:56–00:03:14.
Broken dynamic lighting on the battle map halts exploration after a brief glimpse of a stairwell; Pat
ends the session after six hours played @ 00:06:00–00:22:21.
In recap, the table concludes the ghost/ghoul ambush while resting would have wiped the party if not for
Rich’s android’s apparent immunity @ 00:22:33–00:57:14.
The table recalls Donovan’s betrayal, and a separate earlier capture by ghosts who caged, aged, and
stole the party’s copy of the Tome of Strahd @ 00:23:43–00:35:05.
The party levels up to 7th level and spends the rest of the session on feat and spell choices
@ 00:29:14–01:04:00+.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Donovan (referenced in recap), two unnamed groups of ghosts/ghouls, [[Strahd von
Zarovich]] (referenced only in OOC discussion)
Places: Castle Ravenloft’s upper dungeon rooms and stairwell, the pulsating red light/gem
Items: the Tome of Strahd (now lost, stolen by ghosts)
Quests: Recover the Tome of Strahd (started, dangling), Escape Castle Ravenloft (dangling — this
is the last recorded session of the campaign)

sessions/2023-09-12-jakedm-ep1-the-gang-.title: 2023-09-12 · The Gang Does a Bank Job, Episode 1
sessions/2023-09-12-jakedm-ep1-the-gang-.content:
Recap
Mitch Copperhead, a dwarf mercenary recruiter, hires the party to rob a bank in Lidurithal and
kill its head guard, Cadillac — already confirmed a doppelganger, part of a wider doppelganger
infiltration of the city. After Ozan talks the price up from 5,000 to 8,000 gold, Copperhead drops the
party outside the city and leaves. They make contact with Mary at the Howling Hooters, who gives
them the bank’s layout and guard schedule; Pat wipes her memory twice with the Wand of Memory Lapse
to erase an awkward encounter. That night a goblin family throws rocks at the party and Pat accidentally
kills the goblin father with conjured wood magic; four city guards searching for Mary are talked out of
the room. The next morning, as the party heads for the bank, four giant burrowing creatures surface and
tunnel toward the bank’s rear, hauling a bronze diamond-shaped device — someone else is also after the
vault. The party uses the resulting chaos to slip in the front entrance as a magical alarm sounds,
cliffhanging just inside.
Key events

Mitch Copperhead hires the party for the bank job and names Cadillac kill-on-sight @ 02:12:06–02:17:01.
Ozan negotiates the fee from 5,000 to 8,000 gold @ 02:17:57.
The party arrives in Lidurithal and finds Mary at the Howling Hooters @ 02:33:04–02:46:26.
Pat uses the Wand of Memory Lapse on Mary twice to cover an awkward misunderstanding @ 02:56:41, @ 03:06:06.
Mary provides the bank’s layout and confirms Cadillac is a doppelganger @ 03:01:14, @ 03:02:24.
A goblin family’s rock-throwing ends with Pat killing the goblin father with conjured wood magic @ 03:24:07–03:43:33.
Four city guards searching for Mary are talked out of finding anyone @ 03:27:48–03:45:01.
Four burrowing creatures surface and tunnel toward the bank hauling a bronze device, while a magical
alarm sends patrons fleeing @ 04:03:38–04:30:54.
The party enters the bank through the front as the session ends @ 04:33:12.

Entities referenced

PCs: Pat’s Wizard, Colt Hopper, Jim Jones, Rich’s android wizard, Seabreeze, Frankie,
Jess’s Witch
NPCs: Mitch Copperhead, Gus (Copperhead’s bulldog-like servant/mount), Mary, Cadillac, the
unnamed Howling Hooters bartender, the goblin father
Places: Lidurithal, Howling Hooters, the unnamed bank
Items: Wand of Memory Lapse, the dynamic dominum

sessions/2023-10-01-jakedm-ep2-cadillac-.title: 2023-10-01 · Ep. 2: Cadillac Gets Away
sessions/2023-10-01-jakedm-ep2-cadillac-.content:
Recap
Still mid-heist, the party dives through tunnels dug by giant burrowing creatures (“bulettes”) to bypass
the bank’s guarded main floor, emerging in the vault room to find Cadillac’s own crew already looting
it. A chaotic three-way brawl follows between the party, Cadillac’s crew, and the increasingly
uncontrollable bulettes: the party kills the enemy healer, puts several enemies to sleep, and drops a
grappling-hooked Pat onto the vault’s safe box. Once the loot chest is free, Pat flies it to the roof and
loots it into a bag of holding. Cadillac’s own wizard casts Darkness over his commander to hide him from
the party — useless against the bulettes’ tremorsense but effective against the PCs — and when it
dissipates, Cadillac has slipped away. The party regroups at a safehouse and splits the haul: gold, a
mithril tail-armor, a flying broom, and the glowing blue orb they were sent to retrieve, the
Dynamo.
Key events

The party enters the bank via a bulette tunnel to bypass the guarded main floor @ 00:26:08–00:29:35.
Cadillac’s crew — orcs, monks, a wizard, and three bulettes — is discovered mid-robbery; Cadillac
declares war @ 00:29:35.
The enemy healer-cleric, who had been keeping Cadillac’s crew alive with AoE heals, is killed @ 02:33:09–02:37:30.
A monk grapples Pat out of the air and ties him to the vault’s safe box @ 01:18:33.
Jess’s Deep Slumber puts two enemies to sleep; one (“Big Sleepy”) is later killed by Cadillac’s own
attack of opportunity when he wakes and stands @ 01:04:53, @ 02:49:08.
Pat lifts and flies the ~200 lb loot chest out through the bulette tunnel @ 02:42:00–02:46:33.
An enemy wizard casts Darkness over Cadillac to hide him from the party @ 03:40:03.
The Darkness dissipates: Cadillac has escaped, leaving only a dead bulette and dismembered guards
@ 04:12:40.
The vault chest’s full contents are revealed and split among the party @ 04:16:56–04:19:15.

Entities referenced

PCs: Pat’s Wizard, Richard Findelberg, Aisling, Seabreeze, Frankie, Jess’s Witch,
Connor’s character, Fish’s character (absent, not actively controlled)
NPCs: Cadillac, Big Sleepy (unnamed enemy monk/orc), the enemy healer-cleric, the enemy mage, the
enemy druid, the orc innkeeper, Calverse
Places: the unnamed bank and vault, the bulette tunnels, the safehouse/pub, “the wall”
Items: the Dynamo, a Broom of Flying, mithril spiked-tail armor, aviators/spectacles
of understanding, bagpipes of accompaniment, a gripply story-scroll

Unresolved
Whether the fox-person seen arguing with bank tellers early in the session is Cadillac himself or a
separate NPC/Fish’s character is ambiguous in the transcript @ 00:20:15.

sessions/2023-10-08-jakedm-ep3-copperhea.title: 2023-10-08 · Copperhead the Doppelganger
sessions/2023-10-08-jakedm-ep3-copperhea.content:
Recap
An interlude, DM’d by Pat rather than Jake, with no established connection to the rest of this campaign
(see jakedm Unresolved). Wizard-professor Jace Gandolfini of Hawthorne College finds
library evidence that a demi-lich believed destroyed may still be alive with its hoard, and a field
report about a newly surfaced map to the legendary Tomb of Horrors. He summons his old friend
Sarkhan Vol back from the front of the Changeling War. The map turns out to be a self-replicating
illusion; after Professor Bumblebee backs out shaken by a nightmare, Jace and Sarkhan share an identical
dream in which a skeleton child offers each of them a Revelation Crystal. Using the crystals, Sarkhan
dispels the map’s illusion, revealing a route to the Tomb of Horrors at the center of the
Isle of Death, a region shrouded in a constitution-draining miasma. The pair spend the next day
at Hawthorne’s crafting workshop bartering and buying their way into bottles of air and a scroll of
Concealed Breath, preparing to depart for the Isle.
Key events

Jace discovers records suggesting a demi-lich thought dead may still be alive, with a Ring of Three
Wishes unrecovered @ 00:49:09.
Jace finds a field report on explorer Sir Elric Vanthor’s map to the Tomb of Horrors @ 00:56:17.
Jace summons Sarkhan back to Hawthorne via arcane message @ 00:59:54; Sarkhan arrives @ 01:03:49.
The pair determine the map is a self-replicating illusion they cannot dispel or disrupt @ 01:26:18–01:41:38.
Professor Bumblebee, shaken by a related nightmare, hands over her notes and backs out @ 01:46:16–01:49:07.
Jace and Sarkhan share an identical dream and each accept a Revelation Crystal from a skeleton child,
waking with a burned brand on the back of their hand @ 01:55:54–01:57:33.
Sarkhan uses his crystal to dispel the map’s illusion, revealing the route to the Tomb of Horrors at
the center of the Isle of Death @ 02:01:41–02:03:05.
The pair craft/buy bottles of air and a scroll of Concealed Breath at Hawthorne’s workshop, bartering
with stockroom clerk Bart @ 02:35:45–03:10:40.
Session ends with the two preparing to depart for the Isle of Death @ 03:07:42.

Entities referenced

PCs: Jace Gandolfini, Sarkhan Vol
NPCs: Peggy (Jace’s secretary), Professor Bumblebee, Talendra Starweaver, Bart, Headmaster Elric
Ravenscroft, Professor Thistledown, Professor Eamon Stormrider, Alistair Tomekeeper, Mary Bell
Greenspring, Sir Elric Vanthor, the ghostly child, the suspected demi-lich
Places: Hawthorne College of Enchantment, the Isle of Death, the Tomb of Horrors, Hawthorne’s
crafting workshop
Items: the cursed map, Revelation Crystals, a pouch of diamond dust, a scroll of Concealed Breath, a
scroll of Dispel Magic, Robe of the Archmage

Unresolved
This session is slugged “Copperhead the Doppelganger” and filed under this campaign, but neither term nor
any matching character appears in the transcript, and it is DM’d by Pat while Jake plays a character —
the opposite of every other session in this campaign. It may be mislabeled or misfiled. No later session
revisits the Tomb of Horrors expedition.

sessions/2023-10-15-jakedm-ep4-burn-it-a.title: 2023-10-15 · Burn It All Down
sessions/2023-10-15-jakedm-ep4-burn-it-a.content:
Recap
The party is ambushed at night by a caravan full of doppelgangers — revealed to be led by
Mitch Copperhead himself, already confirmed a doppelganger. Connor opens with a surprise Hypnotic
Pattern; Pat follows with a new fire spell (Cicero/Sirocco) that drops a column of furnace-hot wind on
the whole caravan. Nutty shoots dead the doppelganger carrying the Dyson Dynamo, dropping it near the
burning carriage — and the Dynamo, apparently charged with souls captured during the bank heist, reacts
to the ongoing magical damage by mirroring Pat’s fire spell across the entire city of Godoy. A
back-alley skirmish becomes a citywide firestorm that kills roughly 90% of the city’s population. The
party spends the rest of the session surviving and escaping the blaze, then looting the ruins — platinum,
a scrying mirror, a Ring of Energy Shroud — while debating how to cover up what happened and whether the
Dynamo needs “better” sources of souls going forward.
Key events

The party is ambushed by Copperhead’s doppelganger caravan at night @ 00:00:15.
Connor opens with a surprise-round Hypnotic Pattern @ 00:05:02.
Pat casts Cicero/Sirocco, a 40-foot blast of furnace-hot wind, on the grouped doppelgangers @ 00:21:51.
Nutty kills the doppelganger carrying the Dyson Dynamo; it drops near the horses @ 00:36:05.
The Dynamo begins glowing and, on a near-maximum d1000 roll, mirrors Pat’s fire spell across the whole
city of Godoy @ 00:56:37–00:56:59.
Rich Dimension Doors the absent NPCs and himself clear of the city @ 01:07:58.
Ozan grabs the fallen Dynamo and flees into an alley, without grabbing Connor, who escapes separately
via a water-breathing spell through a canal @ 01:18:46–01:29:53.
The firestorm re-triggers for seven rounds, citywide; only the party and the capital’s defenders under
a protective “blue dome” survive @ 01:36:19–01:42:41.
The party loots the ruins: 200 surviving platinum, a scrying mirror, a Ring of Energy Shroud
@ 01:43:51–01:46:52.
White-cloaked rescuers question Pat and check survivors for magical markings; he talks his way out
@ 01:50:21.
Rich finishes crafting his Headband of Intellect to +4; it comes with a haunted “eye” that shows him
visions of the burning city @ 02:03:00.
Jake confirms the city suffered roughly 90% mortality and awards the party half a level’s XP
@ 02:06:49–02:17:50.

Entities referenced

PCs: Pat’s Wizard, Jim Jones, Richard Findelberg, Seabreeze, Frankie
NPCs: Mitch Copperhead (killed this session), Bruce (the doppelganger “dog”), Zug Tug, the
white-cloaked rescuers
Places: Godoy, the unnamed bank, a magic-ring/jewelry shop, the capital (under its “blue dome”)
Items: Dyson Dynamo, 200 platinum pieces, a soot-covered scrying mirror, a Ring of Energy Shroud,
Rich’s Headband of Intellect +4, a Wand of Infernal Healing

Unresolved
Whether Godoy is the same city as Lidurithal from episode 1 is never stated outright, though both
sit near the Troll Mountains and both center on the same bank.

sessions/2023-10-24-jakedm-ep5-folding-b.title: 2023-10-24 · Folding Boat Refugees
sessions/2023-10-24-jakedm-ep5-folding-b.content:
Recap
The party watches Godoy burn from the walls, confirms nobody outside the party yet knows who caused
it, and investigates the drained soul-storing device from the bank job — a roll of 30 from Jess
(not a natural 20, despite Jake’s assumption) reveals it crosses planes, likely siphoning souls elsewhere.
Rather than stay, they disguise
themselves and join the refugee column, picking Lutathal as their destination, home to the annual
Magic Carpet Race. Jess reveals her folding boat, “Nessie,” and the party sails and then flies it ahead
of the column. That night, Pat scries on Cadillac for seven minutes and learns he’s privately planning
to purge and re-vet changelings near the king now that most of Godoy’s changeling population is dead. The
party reaches Lutathal ahead of the refugees — Pat trips a magical alarm sneaking in disguised and
invisible — reunites inside, and learns about the race from a tavern waitress. Negotiations with carpet-
maker Greg for race sponsorship collapse after Ozan jokingly offers Rich as collateral; Jess curses Greg
in retaliation. The party still formally registers for the race under ticket #7, three days before it
starts.
Key events

The party watches Godoy burn from the walls; a blue magical dome covers the inner Capitol
@ 00:12:40–00:14:17.
Pat and Jess examine the drained soul-storing cylinder; Jess rolls a 30 (not a natural
20) revealing it crosses planes @ 00:19:10–00:22:07.
The party joins the refugee column and picks Lutathal as its destination, site of the Magic Carpet
Race @ 00:26:13–00:29:12.
Jess proposes using her folding boat and names it “Nessie,” summoning it in full ship form
@ 00:33:38–00:44:41.
Pat scries on Cadillac for seven minutes, learning of his planned changeling purge near the king
@ 00:49:09–00:54:54.
The party floats the boat and flies it roughly twelve hours to Lutathal, arriving ahead of the
refugees; “Scorching Rays” is floated as a joke team name @ 01:02:22–01:17:11, @ 01:03:26.
Pat flees the city gate in a blown disguise, trips a magical Alarm sneaking in invisible, and reunites
with the party inside @ 01:27:56–01:56:19.
A tavern waitress tells the party about the race and a recently thwarted demon-summoning cult
@ 02:18:01–02:27:58.
Sponsorship negotiations with carpet-maker Greg collapse; Jess curses him to count every board in his
shop @ 02:28:58–03:18:00.
The party registers for the race, receiving ticket #7 and a shot at the 50,000 gp prize, and settles on
the team name “Scorching Rays” @ 02:52:47–02:53:46, @ 02:57:55–02:57:58.

Entities referenced

PCs: Pat’s Wizard, Richard Findelberg, Jess’s Witch, Frankie, Connor’s character,
Seabreeze
NPCs: Cadillac, Gustav (refugee teen wizard), the Lutathal lead gate guard, Riggs, Benji, the
tavern waitress, Greg, Lois/Louise, Randy (Pat’s luck-dragon familiar)
Places: Godoy, Lutathal, Eaton Leek (site of the foiled cult)
Items: the soul-storing cylinder, the scrying mirror, sleeve of many garments, the
folding boat “Nessie,” onyx token #7

Unresolved
Whether “Pearl Mountains” and “Troll Mountains” refer to the same range near Godoy/Lutathal is
unclear from the transcript.

sessions/2023-11-28-jakedm-ep6-the-gang-.title: 2023-11-28 · Ep.6 — The Gang Gets a Shitty Old Carpet
sessions/2023-11-28-jakedm-ep6-the-gang-.content:
Recap
Outside the rug shop in Lutathal (called Liduriel/Kalooza this session), two astral-projected
TIU investigators, Thornshade and Iron Soul, confront the party over the Dyson Dynamo — an
artifact they say could “unravel the fabric of reality.” A tense standoff ends when a giant orca bouncer,
Gang, brawls Thornshade into conceding; Thornshade shows his real badge, explains the Dynamo harvests
souls, and marks the party as suspects regardless of Donnie’s bluff denying any knowledge of it.
The party recruits Gang outright. Learning the race (the Rug Mandela, 20,000 gold winner-take-all) starts
the next morning and they have no carpet, the party bluffs and intimidates a shopkeeper out of a discarded
firework-carpet “jalopy,” memory-wiping him to cover the scheme. At the racers’ club, the Pierrot,
Donovan snorts a drug called “whimsy,” catches an invisible pickpocket, and the party becomes local heroes
buying the bar a round. The session ends on a fresh cliffhanger: the sky turns blood red and a massive
demon rises up through the city streets.
Key events

Jake recaps: the party nearly firebombed the rug shop; Richard was bartered into servitude to avoid
paying for a carpet @ 00:12:38–00:13:23.
Two astral-projected TIU investigators, Thornshade and Iron Soul, confront the party over the
Dyson Dynamo @ 00:35:54–00:38:52.
Ashleen (leenmcweenersten’s witch) tries to pick Thornshade’s pocket and her hand passes right through
him, revealing the agents as astral projections @ 00:43:08–00:43:22.
Gang, a bar bouncer, fights and defeats Thornshade @ 00:57:45–01:08:03.

@ 01:08:41–01:12:08.

sessions/2025-03-31-dungeonvice-sesh3.title: 2025-03-31 · DungeonVice – Session 3
sessions/2025-03-31-dungeonvice-sesh3.content:
Recap
The inspectors regroup at the office after capturing a woman during a break-in that turned out to be a
ruse of her own making. Given a choice between chasing leads on “the boot” — the new troll crime lord
running Turgeth’s drug trade — or a pending aqueducts job, the party chooses the boot. Jerry
teleports them to the Council chambers, where Ozone flirts the prisoner into talking: her husband
Riggs, Turgeth’s previous crime boss, lost a bargain with a devil and was dragged to hell; she
engineered her own capture to find a hidden golden ticket — a one-way pass to confront the devil and
reunite with Riggs. She also reveals the drug Maka flooding the city is secretly supplied by the
College of Turgeth itself.
Jerry teleports the party to a dockside warehouse tied to the boot. Ozan plies a drunk lookout, Dex,
with moonshine and cocaine, but Dex signals an alarm and a firefight erupts; Ozone’s Glitter Dust blinds
the guards, who shoot and stab each other by accident. Rich sprints ahead alone, running past Fugly
(the boot’s orc enforcer) rather than stopping to fight. Fugly follows him downstairs and nearly drops him
with a 36-damage crit — partway through this fight Rich and Nutty, unsure of his rank, start calling him
“the captain” — before Nutty catches up and finishes him off, yielding a pair of enchanted Boots of Haste.
As the crew’s ship hoists sail, Ozan torches the warehouse, and a hasted, ethereal Rich flies after the
departing ship, spotting The Boot himself — unaware Rich is floating invisibly feet away. The session
ends mid-chase.
Key events

00:00:22 Jake recaps: the prisoner’s “break-in” was a self-orchestrated ruse to retrieve a hidden ticket.
00:02:38 Jake establishes the boot took over Turgeth’s drug trade after former boss Riggs was “sucked back into hell.”
00:06:24 Jerry returns with a broken finger, courtesy of the new prisoner.
00:07:25 Volto reminds the team about the still-pending Aqueducts Assignment.
00:11:58 Party teleports to the Council chambers; archivist Loren Fenn logs their visit.
00:15:20 The prisoner recognizes and flirts with Ozone in her cell.
00:17:41 She reveals her husband Riggs lost a bargain with a devil and was dragged to hell.
00:19:45 She admits she used the boot to get captured and track the party back to their HQ, hunting the Golden Ticket to the Devil.
00:24:08-00:24:19 She reveals the drug Maka is secretly supplied by the College of Turgeth.
00:25:03 She reveals it’s worth ~75,000 gp/week.
00:32:02 Jake establishes the College of Turgeth specializes in aberration/self-protection magic.
00:40:27-00:42:21 Jerry teleports the party to a dockside warehouse, one of the boot’s known haunts.
00:56:49 Ozan cozies up to drunk dockworker Dex, trading moonshine and cocaine for information.
01:05:14-01:06:02 Dex fires a flare and pulls a gun, revealing himself as a lookout; combat begins.
01:15:07 Ozan casts Glitter Dust, blinding the guards, who begin shooting and stabbing each other.
01:37:48 Rich sprints ahead alone to chase the signal flare, leaving Ozan and Nutty with the blinded guards.
01:39:02-01:39:20 Rich runs into an orc with twin machetes, confirmed by Jake to be Fugly, and
runs past rather than stopping to fight.
01:52:32-01:53:30 Fugly, who followed Rich down the stairs, critically wounds him for 36 damage;
partway through this fight Rich and Nutty, unsure of his rank, start calling him “the captain”
(01:43:49, 01:55:17) — see The Guard Captain for the resulting Unresolved note.
02:38:24 The party hears the crew hoisting sail — the boot is escaping by ship.
02:46:05-02:48:22 Nutty catches up to Rich downstairs and, flanking with him, finishes off Fugly
with a combined weapon-and-shocking-grasp strike (“Washashaka”).
02:48:42 Rich loots Fugly’s Boots of Haste from the corpse.
02:58:23-03:02:43 Rich activates the Boots of Haste and turns ethereal.
03:09:40-03:10:13 Flying through the warehouse, Rich spots The Boot, a giant troll, on deck of
the departing ship, unseen by him.
03:13:57-03:14:24 Ozan sets the warehouse on fire with a tossed cigarette as he and Nutty retreat.
03:18:05 The party levels up; Pat will level up a session behind due to his absence.
03:19:55 Nutty gives Ozan a Ring of Protection +1.
03:16:52 Jake narrates the cliffhanger ending, Rich flying toward the fleeing ship, mid-chase; the
group says its actual goodnights a few minutes later 03:22:27.

Entities referenced

PCs: Rich’s Monk (DungeonVice), Nutty’s Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice), Ozone,
Pat’s Wizard (DungeonVice)
NPCs: Jerry, Loren Fenn, Riggs’s Widow, Riggs, The Boot, Fugly, Dex,
The Guard Captain, Volto
Places: The Inspectors’ Office, Council Chambers (Turgeth), The Holding Cells (Turgeth),
Dockside Warehouse (Turgeth), Turgeth
Factions: College of Turgeth
Items: Golden Ticket to the Devil, Boots of Haste, Ring of Protection +1,
“Whoop Whoop” Whistle, Nutty’s Tail Weapon, Maka
Quests: Hunt for the Boot, Retrieve the Golden Ticket, College of Turgeth Drug Pipeline,
Aqueducts Assignment

Unresolved
The captured prisoner’s name was never stated — see Riggs’s Widow. “Captain Elas,” mentioned once by
Loren Fenn, could not be confirmed as a real recurring name or a mishearing 00:12:48. The drug is named
“Maka” explicitly but “Rama” is used once earlier for what may be the same drug 00:24:19 00:43:47. The
ship’s destination, heard as “Rolesk,” is likely a mangled place name 00:59:19. Nutty’s weapon-combo
ability was heard as both “Washashaka” and “Walshashah.” Whether “the captain” (01:43:49, 01:55:17)
was a second enemy or just Rich and Nutty’s own nickname for Fugly mid-fight is unresolved — see
The Guard Captain; Jake’s narration never confirms a second named enemy and still calls him “the orc”
at 01:48:40, so this wiki now treats them as the same NPC.
DM notes (spoiler)

Jake tells the players (OOC) the guard captain who crit Rich was likely a mid/high-level fighter (around
level 10-11), info the characters never learn in-game 02:55:27-02:57:32.
Jake plans to “remix” Ozan’s whistle item’s mechanics after the session 03:19:44.
Jake admits (OOC) that running this fight with only three active players (Pat absent) made it harder
than intended, calling it “a complete failure on my part” despite the party’s success 03:19:03.
